providers.name: Greenplaces
providers.description: Greenplaces is a sustainability and ESG reporting platform that pairs software with expert consulting to help companies — especially suppliers responding to enterprise requirements — measure their carbon footprint under the GHG Protocol and complete sustainability framework submissions including CDP, EcoVadis, SBTi, GRI, SASB/ISSB and GRESB. The managed-service platform also supports B Corp certification, CSRD readiness, SOC 2 and AI-governance compliance, and tracking of regulations such as California SB 253 and SB 261. Greenplaces is venture-backed by Felicis and Redpoint Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; the company publishes a managed product (app.greenplaces.com) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Greyparrot
providers.description: Greyparrot is a London-based AI waste analytics company that turns materials recovery facilities (MRFs) into data-driven operations. Its Greyparrot Analyzer uses computer-vision cameras mounted over waste conveyor belts to identify, count, and measure the composition of waste streams in real time, giving recyclers continuous visibility into what flows through their plant. The Greyparrot Sync product routes that analytics stream into existing operational control systems, ERP platforms, Power BI dashboards, and OEM sortation hardware (robotic arms, air-jet systems, balers, belt control), while Deepnest turns real-world recovery data into design feedback for packaging brands. Backed by Speedinvest, Greyparrot serves recyclers, equipment manufacturers, and consumer-goods companies working to raise recycling rates and automate compliance reporting. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public web, product, and content surface.

providers.name: KITRO
providers.description: KITRO is a Swiss company founded in 2017 in Zurich that helps professional kitchens measure and reduce food waste through AI-powered automation. Its KITRO TARE device pairs an IoT scale with a camera and computer vision to automatically identify, weigh and categorize discarded food with no change to kitchen workflow, feeding a cloud analytics dashboard that surfaces waste trends by time, item and station, compares performance across properties, and exports reports for sustainability and EU food-waste compliance reporting. KITRO serves hotel groups and resorts, hospitals and care homes, corporate canteens, universities and schools, and river and ocean cruise operators in 20+ countries, with customers including Marriott, Hyatt, TUI BLUE, Pestana, 25hours Hotels and Sydney Opera Bar. KITRO publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer portal — the only customer-facing software surface is the authenticated dashboard at my.kitro.ch — but it does publish an llms.txt agent-readable company description at www.kitro.ch/llms.txt.

providers.name: Spoiler Alert
providers.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Twelve
providers.description: Twelve is a carbon transformation company that converts CO2, water, and renewable electricity into fuels and chemicals that serve as drop-in replacements for petroleum-based products. Its proprietary eManufacturing technology powers AirPlant One in Moses Lake, Washington, which produces E-Jet sustainable aviation fuel and E-Naphtha, while its eMade program partners with consumer brands on CO2-made materials. Investors include TPG, DCVC, Microsoft, Carbon Direct, Breakout Ventures, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. Twelve publishes no public developer API, but its Wix-hosted site exposes an llms.txt and a live site MCP endpoint for agentic access.

providers.name: Inspire
providers.description: Inspire (Inspire Clean Energy) is a consumer clean-energy company on a mission to transform the way people access clean energy and accelerate a net-zero carbon future. It gives residential customers access to renewable energy for their home electricity supply through flat-rate subscription plans designed to deliver predictability and reduce exposure to electricity rate volatility. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface — this is a non-API consumer brand.

providers.name: Jaipur Robotics
providers.description: Jaipur Robotics is a Manno, Switzerland based deep-tech company building advanced computer vision and deep learning solutions for the waste-to-energy sector. Its product, Jaipur Intelligence, applies patent-pending image recognition to plant bunkers and truck unloading bays to detect oversized and dangerous items, map the calorific value (LHV) of incoming waste in real time, and track crane operations — helping operators cut emissions, improve waste mixing and combustion stability, and minimize unplanned shutdowns. The company operates a gated customer application at app.jaipurrobotics.com and is backed by Techstars, Innosuisse, Venture Kick, CSEM and others. It currently publishes a marketing site and a customer login only; there is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: PortF
providers.description: PortF is an AI-powered portfolio monitoring platform for private equity, venture capital, and institutional investors. It automates investment data collection and reporting by extracting qualitative and quantitative data from emails, documents, and 25+ connected systems (Excel, OneDrive, SharePoint, SSO, Salesforce, FIS Global, Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and NetSuite), then consolidates financial, ESG, and impact data into a single source of truth with real-time analytics, IRR benchmarking, and agentic reporting workflows. Founded by Alex Lu and headquartered in London, PortF is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Revivn
providers.description: Revivn provides an integrated hardware lifecycle platform for managing end-of-life IT equipment. The company handles secure device pickup, certified data sanitization and destruction, and redistribution of usable hardware to underserved communities through nonprofit partnerships. Its software surface (the Revivn App at app.revivn.com) lets IT and asset-management teams schedule retrievals, track chain-of-custody, generate compliance and sustainability reporting, and — per Revivn's marketing — integrate Revivn's API with their IT software stack for customized workflows. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDK is published; the integration API appears to be a private, enterprise-only surface. Revivn is a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Electric Car Scheme
providers.description: The Electric Car Scheme is a UK B Corp providing electric vehicle salary sacrifice as an employee benefit. Employees lease any electric car of their choice with the monthly cost deducted from gross salary before Income Tax and National Insurance, saving 20-50% versus a personal lease, while employers save on Class 1A National Insurance. Packages are all-inclusive (lease, insurance, maintenance, servicing and breakdown) with Complete Protection covering employees who leave partway through a lease term. The company integrates with employer payroll systems via API or SFTP and offers Single Sign-On for employees, plus an included Charge Scheme for charging access.

providers.name: Bonnet
providers.description: Bonnet is a UK-based electric vehicle (EV) charging app that aggregates multiple charging networks into a single platform, letting drivers find, access, and pay for chargers across Europe through one membership. Headquartered in Bristol and acquired by OVO Energy, it gives consumers real-time charger status, route planning, membership plans with per-charge savings, and weekly charging-credit rewards, while offering charge point operator (CPO) and fleet solutions with white-label integration for businesses. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Bonnet publishes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Dandelion Energy
providers.description: Dandelion Energy is a residential geothermal heating and cooling company that designs, engineers, and installs ground-source heat pump systems for homeowners and new-home builders. Its systems tap the earth's stable subsurface temperature to heat and cool homes year-round, cutting utility bills and carbon emissions versus conventional fossil-fuel HVAC. Dandelion delivers end-to-end service from ground-loop drilling through turnkey installation, and offers a leasing program that removes the upfront cost for buyers. The company reports thousands of installations across the United States. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), it operates in the frontier-tech and climate sector; it currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Roby
providers.description: Roby (Imageous, Inc.) is a Seattle-based building-management software company whose HVAC automation product connects room and space calendars with a building's BMS (building management system) to automatically switch HVAC to an unoccupied/energy-saving mode when spaces are not in use, delivering measured energy savings and extended equipment lifetime for K-12, higher-education, and office facilities without added staff effort. Roby is deployed through building system integrators (ATS, Climatec, Syserco, ABM Systems, Oprizon, NSF-E) and also offers Receptionist and Helpdesk workplace applications. The product uses Auth0-managed authentication with token-based, SSL-only API access, but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Optivolt Labs
providers.description: Optivolt Labs (operating as Optivolt) is a Burlingame, California solar technology company building intelligent home solar systems with power electronics embedded directly inside each panel. Its patented Balancer device shuffles power from stronger to weaker zones within a panel to keep energy flowing in shaded and non-ideal conditions, delivering up to 50% more annual energy and improved shaded performance versus conventional panels. The product line includes 450W N-type mono half-cut panels, universal battery and inverter compatibility, and a real-time monitoring app for tracking energy and savings. Optivolt is a Techstars-backed hardware company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Conservation Labs
providers.description: Conservation Labs is a Pittsburgh-based smart water technology company, backed by Techstars, Amazon, RET Ventures and SustainVC. Its flagship product, H2know, is a clamp-on acoustic smart water monitor that measures a building's inbound pipe every second and uses patented sound-detection technology and machine learning to translate those signals into accurate water-flow estimates, leak alerts and water-usage insights delivered through a companion mobile and web app. The company also offers Sustainable Machines, an edge-to-cloud platform for machine condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Conservation Labs serves residential homes, commercial real estate, restaurants and hotels, and industrial operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing app but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook documentation.

providers.name: Eliq
providers.description: Eliq provides energy data and analytics APIs for utilities and energy app developers. The platform combines a decade of analytics and machine learning trained on millions of homes to deliver consumption insights, disaggregation, forecasting, peak detection, tariff comparison, and customer segmentation.

providers.name: Junk King
providers.description: Junk King is a professional junk removal and hauling franchise operating across the United States and Canada as part of the Neighborly family of home service brands. Through locally owned and operated locations, Junk King provides full-service junk removal, self-service dumpster rental, and dumpster bag pickup for residential and commercial customers, handling appliance and furniture removal, estate and property cleanouts, construction debris, yard waste, and e-waste. The company emphasizes eco-friendly disposal, recycling, donating, and reusing as much collected material as possible. Junk King offers free estimates, same-day service in many markets, and online, phone, and text-based booking. It is a portfolio company associated with Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Junk King publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Mill
providers.description: Mill is a consumer sustainability company that makes a smart kitchen bin which dries and grinds household food scraps overnight into dry, nutrient-rich "Food Grounds," keeping food waste out of landfills and cutting the methane it would otherwise produce. Sold as a membership starting around $799 or roughly $66/month, the bin is odorless, reduces food-waste volume by about 80%, and the resulting grounds are reused in gardens, as chicken feed, or through farm partnerships. Mill also runs a commercial line for grocery, offices, food service, and municipalities. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Mill is a consumer hardware and subscription business with a companion mobile app; it exposes no public developer API — its /api/ path is an internal app backend disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Misfits Market (fka Imperfect Foods)
providers.description: Misfits Market is an online grocery delivery service that rescues surplus and cosmetically imperfect produce, plus organic vegetables, dairy, meat, seafood, pantry staples, and wine, delivering sustainable groceries across the United States to help reduce food waste. It merged with Imperfect Foods in 2022, and both brands now operate under Misfits Market. The company has no public developer API program: its digital surface is a consumer e-commerce website, a customer help center, and iOS/Android mobile apps. It publishes a machine-readable llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: Anker Innovations
providers.description: Anker Innovations is a global consumer-electronics company headquartered in Shenzhen, China, known for its Anker charging and power products, Soundcore audio, eufy smart-home and security devices, Nebula projectors, and Anker SOLIX portable power and solar storage. Through the Anker Open Platform (developer.anker.com) the company exposes a developer surface that lets partners integrate and control Anker devices from their own applications via API and SDK, gated behind an Open Platform login. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and is being enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Iontra
providers.description: Iontra Inc. is a Denver, Colorado battery technology company that develops proprietary Charge-Control technology for rechargeable lithium batteries. Founded in 2013 and publicly launched in 2022, Iontra applies electrodynamic sensing and signal processing during charging to suppress lithium plating, dendrite growth and SEI-layer expansion, claiming up to 4x cycle life, 2x faster charging, improved cold-weather charging and better safety without changing cell chemistry. The technology is chemistry agnostic across Li-ion, Li-metal, Li-S, solid-state and Na-ion cells, and is delivered to OEMs as custom charging algorithm "recipes" flashed onto an application-specific microcontroller, or as a software-only library. Iontra closed a $45M Series C led by Volta Energy Technologies to launch an integrated RISC-V charge-control and fuel-gauge MCU. Iontra is an embedded/silicon company: it publishes no public web API, no OpenAPI, and no public SDK packages — its SDK is firmware delivered to OEM customers through a login-gated Document Portal under commercial engagement.

providers.name: Cactos
providers.description: Cactos is a Finnish clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and operates smart battery energy storage systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and grid-scale use. Its hardware line (Cactos Mylo commercial storage and Cactos Cardo backup power, built in part from second-life Tesla EV batteries) is paired with Cactos Spine, a cloud software platform that optimizes each unit for load shifting, peak shaving, demand-charge reduction, solar self-consumption, backup power during outages, and participation in electricity and grid-balancing markets. Cactos serves logistics, manufacturing, EV charging, agriculture, real estate, and commercial-property operators. It is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. As of this profile, Cactos publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; the Cactos Spine app at app.cactos.com is a customer-facing management console rather than a documented developer API.

providers.name: Emidat
providers.description: Emidat GmbH is a Munich-based climate technology company building product intelligence infrastructure for the construction industry. Its SaaS platform lets construction material manufacturers create verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), run Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), and produce Digital Product Passports (DPPs) at scale. Emidat ingests plant, ERP, and energy-management data through integrations, performs intelligent data matching, and generates ISO-compliant, verified EPDs in as little as a day rather than the typical six to twelve months. The platform also surfaces environmental-impact hotspots so manufacturers can find emission-reduction opportunities and turn sustainability data into business value. Related tools include the public EPD Database and Emidat Atlas.

providers.name: Ameren
providers.description: Ameren Corporation is a regulated electric and natural gas utility serving customers in Missouri and Illinois. The company provides reliable energy delivery, smart grid infrastructure, and renewable energy programs. Ameren Illinois implements the Green Button Connect My Data program (Share My Usage) based on the ESPI standard, enabling authorized third parties to access customer energy usage data. Ameren also operates a Renewables Portal for community solar generation owners and participates in grid modernization initiatives.

providers.name: AMP Robotics
providers.description: AMP Robotics (operating as AMP Sortation) is an artificial-intelligence company for the waste and recycling industry that designs, builds, and operates advanced, cost-competitive facilities to process single-stream recycling and municipal solid waste. Its Smart Sortation technology suite combines computer vision (real-time material characterization), high-speed air-jet sortation (Jet and MicroJet), and robotic-arm sortation (Delta) to raise material-recovery rates, cut contamination, and extend landfill life. The flagship AMP ONE platform delivers fully automated, facility-scale sortation processing from 10K to 1M+ tons annually for waste haulers, material-recovery facilities, and municipalities. AMP Robotics is a Google Ventures (GV) portfolio company. No public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal is published; this profile is maintained for network discovery and identity.

providers.name: Beewise
providers.description: Beewise is an agricultural technology company building the BeeHome, an AI- and robotics-enabled beehive that autonomously monitors, cares for, and protects honeybee colonies to reduce colony loss and deliver reliable pollination. Founded to address bee colony collapse, Beewise combines computer vision, robotics, and cloud software to detect pests and disease, regulate hive climate, and dispatch precision pollination for growers. The company serves growers with guaranteed pollination services, beekeepers with technology-enhanced hive management, and property owners through its Bees for Buildings program. Beewise is a venture-backed company (Insight Partners portfolio) surfaced into the API Evangelist network; it operates a customer grower portal but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: Dimension
providers.description: Dimension is a nationwide, on-demand waste management and junk removal platform (formerly Trash Warrior) backed by 500 Global. It offers digital booking with instant AI-generated pricing (their "Mirror Mirror AI" quoter), same-day and next-day pickup for cardboard, appliances, mattresses, hazardous and medical waste, plus dumpster rentals, for both businesses and individuals. Every job includes tracking with detailed diversion data, receipts, and photos, and can be booked as a one-off or recurring service. Dimension has been awarded a State of California RFP contract for PPE waste removal. The company operates a customer-facing booking application and help center but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Grove Collaborative
providers.description: Grove Collaborative is a digital-first consumer products company and online marketplace for sustainable everyday household essentials — eco-friendly cleaning supplies, bamboo and recycled paper products, personal care, beauty, pet, and vitamins & supplements from hundreds of vetted brands. Orders meet strict ingredient standards and are carbon neutral, and the company operates as a plastic-neutral, sustainability-focused retailer sold through grove.co (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and retail partners. Grove is a public benefit company (NYSE: GROV) that was an early portfolio company of 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. It publishes no first-party developer API or public developer program; this profile captures its public web, security, and Shopify-platform discovery surface.

providers.name: Highstock
providers.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Imperfect Foods
providers.description: Imperfect Foods is a consumer grocery delivery service focused on reducing food waste. It sources surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and excess-inventory food — produce that is too large or small, packaging overstock, near best-by-date items, and manufacturing byproducts — and delivers them to members at a discount through a weekly, customizable grocery order of produce, meat, seafood, dairy, pantry staples, and snacks. Imperfect Foods was acquired by Misfits Market in 2022 and now operates as part of that company; its consumer web and mobile apps remain live. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment — this profile is maintained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Misfits Market
providers.description: Misfits Market is a subscription-based online grocery delivery service founded in 2018 by Abhi Ramesh and headquartered in Philadelphia. It rescues surplus, cosmetically imperfect, and near-best-by organic produce, pantry staples, dairy, and meat, then delivers them to customers at a discount to reduce food waste. Members shop a personalized storefront during a weekly delivery window with no subscription fees or order minimums, and can skip or cancel anytime. The company acquired rival Imperfect Foods in 2022 and The Rounds in 2025. Backed by Accel and SoftBank Vision Fund. Misfits Market operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Planet FWD
providers.description: Planet FWD is a decarbonization software platform that helps consumer brands measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions. It provides AI-powered product life cycle assessments (LCAs), corporate greenhouse-gas inventories across Scope 1, 2, and 3, and supply-chain decarbonization scenario planning for food & beverage, retail, and apparel companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: ReelData AI
providers.description: ReelData AI builds artificial intelligence software for land-based aquaculture, helping recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) fish farms maximize growth, minimize costs, and reduce risk across smolt, post-smolt, and on-growing production. Its integrated AI suite includes AI Smart Feeding (ReelAppetite), which monitors real-time population appetite to optimize feed and cut waste; AI Biomass Monitoring (ReelWeight), a non-intrusive biomass estimation tool returning results within hours; and AI Cameras (ReelVision), dual-function cameras for fish-behavior monitoring, feed counting, and standard IP camera use. Additional tools cover stress monitoring (ReelStress) and early disease detection (ReelHealth). ReelData is a Techstars portfolio company serving major operators including Samherji, Atlantic Sapphire, Kingfish Company, and Salmon Evolution. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface; its products are delivered as on-site AI hardware and software rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Rheaply
providers.description: Rheaply is a circular-economy platform for enterprise asset lifecycle management. It gives organizations real-time inventory visibility, an internal reuse marketplace with approval workflows for reallocating surplus furniture, equipment, IT assets, and lab supplies, and sustainable disposition through a network of 3,400+ verified nonprofit and commercial partners. Rheaply helps companies, universities, and governments cut procurement costs, divert waste from landfill, track embodied-carbon savings, and run decommissioning and office move-outs. Backed by Techstars, the company operates a web application at app.rheaply.com. As of this enrichment pass Rheaply publishes no public developer/API program, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Smartex
providers.description: Smartex is an AI and computer-vision company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Porto, Portugal that builds hardware-enabled software for the textile manufacturing industry. Its systems inspect fabric in real time on the knitting machine to detect defects at the source, cutting textile waste, CO2 emissions, water, energy and rework. The product suite spans CORE (a machine-vision inspection add-on for circular knitting machines), FACT (an all-in-one digital factory-management platform for production visibility and quality control) and LOOP (supply-chain communication and traceability). Smartex is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, DCVC, Tony Fadell's Build Collective, H&M Group, SOSV/HAX, Spider Capital, Momenta Ventures and Fashion for Good. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; customer access is through the FACT platform login. This profile was surfaced from the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched from Smartex's public web surface.

providers.name: SustainCERT
providers.description: SustainCERT is an independent, digitally-enabled climate impact verification company. It provides third-party validation and verification for carbon-market projects, corporate greenhouse-gas inventories and climate reporting, value-chain (Scope 3) decarbonization claims, and digital monitoring, reporting and verification (DMRV) for renewable energy and product carbon footprints. Customers work through the SustainCERT web platform; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Partech portfolio and enriched with domain-security probes and identity metadata.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: WiredScore
providers.description: WiredScore is the global standard-setting organization for digital connectivity and smart technology in the built environment. It assesses, benchmarks, and certifies buildings through two programs — WiredScore (digital connectivity) and SmartScore (smart building technology) — across office, residential, industrial, and hotel asset types. Landlords, developers, and occupiers in more than 40 countries use its certifications and its network of Accredited Professionals to demonstrate that a building meets modern technology and connectivity expectations; over 4,000 buildings covering roughly one billion square feet have been certified. WiredScore is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface.

providers.name: GE Vernova
providers.description: GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy through its innovative portfolio of electrification, power, and decarbonization technologies. Spun off from General Electric, GE Vernova brings together the legacy GE Power, Renewable Energy, Digital, and Energy Financial Services businesses to help solve the world's energy transition challenges.

providers.name: General Fusion
providers.description: General Fusion is a Canadian fusion energy company founded in 2002 by physicist Dr. Michel Laberge and headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia, in the Vancouver area. It is developing Magnetized Target Fusion (MTF), an approach that combines plasma formation, mechanical compression by a liquid metal liner, and practical heat capture for electricity generation. The company operates LM26, which it describes as the world's largest and most powerful operational fusion plasma injector, and reports 24 plasma prototypes, more than 200,000 plasma experiments, 35+ peer-reviewed papers, and roughly 210 issued and pending patents. In July 2026 General Fusion completed a business combination with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III and became the first publicly listed fusion energy company, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker GFUZ. It is an energy hardware and research company rather than a software or API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contracts. Its only machine-readable public surfaces are a Yoast-generated llms.txt and the WordPress REST discovery index behind its marketing site.

providers.name: Genomatica
providers.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.

providers.name: Hometree
providers.description: Hometree is a UK home services and residential energy company offering homeowners and landlords subscription-based boiler and home emergency cover with unlimited repairs and annual maintenance from around £12.95 per month. Its nationwide network of Gas Safe registered engineers handles breakdowns across heating, plumbing, electrics, drainage and gas fires, and the company also arranges boiler installations and green home upgrades such as heat pumps and solar panels. Operating as an insurance distributor and installer across mainland England, Scotland and Wales, Hometree is backed by Anthemis, DN Capital, Barclays, BlackRock, 2150 and Puma Growth Partners.

providers.name: Omnidian
providers.description: Omnidian, Inc. is a Seattle-based clean energy performance assurance company, founded in 2015, that protects and accelerates investments in residential and commercial solar and battery storage. Its proprietary, machine-learning driven software platform continuously monitors distributed solar assets, diagnoses hardware, communication and environmental faults such as soiling, shading and snow, dispatches a nationwide field service technician network across 48 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, and underwrites a 95% energy production guarantee that reimburses owners for covered shortfalls. Omnidian serves installers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, solar financing providers, commercial real estate owners and asset investors, and is a Certified B Corporation and a member of the SunSpec Alliance. Its monitoring platform, client portal and field service partner portal are operated as private, authenticated systems; Omnidian publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Gridware
providers.description: Gridware builds grid intelligence technology for electric utilities. Its Active Grid Response (AGR) platform pairs pole-mounted GridScope sensors with analytics to bring real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental condition of every span of the distribution grid, closing the "Hazard Awareness Delay" between when a fault or hazard occurs and when a utility detects it. Gridware supports fault prevention, faster power restoration, wildfire and hazard response, and grid asset management. Headquartered in San Francisco with an Applied Research Complex in Richmond, California, the company is backed by True Ventures. Gridware does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity, trust/compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: kWh Analytics
providers.description: kWh Analytics is a Beaverton, Oregon based managing general agent and data-analytics firm that underwrites property and performance insurance for renewable energy assets — solar, wind, and battery storage. Founded in 2012 and acquired by specialist insurer Beazley in 2023, the company operates what it describes as the industry's largest solar performance database, covering roughly 30% of U.S. solar assets across 300,000+ renewable energy assets and $100B+ in loss data. Its HelioStats platform ingests unstructured asset production documents (via AWS S3, Box, Dropbox, email attachment, or API) and applies OCR and machine learning to extract, validate, standardize, benchmark, and enrich operating data for investors, lenders, and asset owners. Commercial products include data-driven Property Insurance, the Solar Revenue Put credit enhancement, the Wind Proxy Hedge, and the SolarScape market intelligence offering. kWh Analytics also publishes the annual Solar Risk Assessment industry report. There is no public developer portal, published API reference, or machine-readable API specification — data delivery and the HelioStats ingest API are arranged through enterprise engagement.

providers.name: SkySpecs
providers.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

providers.name: Cool Planet
providers.description: CoolPlanet is an enterprise energy-management and decarbonisation software company. Its platform, CoolPlanetOS, centralises real-time energy data across multi-site industrial estates, applies AI-driven anomaly detection and efficiency insights, benchmarks performance across facilities, and automates energy and compliance reporting. CoolPlanet pairs the software with consulting and on-site execution services to help manufacturing, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, commercial real estate, mining and shipping enterprises cut energy costs and carbon emissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Diligent
providers.description: Diligent Corporation is a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its board management portal (Diligent Boards / Boardbooks) and the broader Diligent One Platform, which unifies board management, enterprise risk, audit, compliance, entity management, and ESG. The board portal itself is a security-hardened product with no public developer API - it is integrated through SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning, and packaged connectors (Okta, Microsoft 365/Teams, Zoom, DocuSign). Diligent does, however, publish a real developer portal at developer.diligent.com covering the GRC side of the platform - the HighBond (Diligent One) REST API for audit/risk/compliance data, a GraphQL Entities API for legal-entity and subsidiary management, an ESG API for activity/usage data, and a Workflow API for jobs, tasks, and campaigns. API access is customer/partner-gated (a HighBond API key or SSO-scoped token is required) and pricing is quote-based via Diligent sales.

providers.name: Phononic
providers.description: Phononic is a Durham, North Carolina solid-state cooling company founded by CEO Tony Atti that replaces compressor-based refrigeration with semiconductor thermoelectric devices. Its products cool optical and fiber transceivers, co-packaged optics, GPU high-bandwidth memory, LiDAR sensors, medical and vaccine cold chain, grocery retail merchandising and HVAC. The current focus is AI data centers, where the Thermal Kit and Thermal Fabric combine thermoelectric cooling chips with embedded control firmware that the company markets as API-accessible and Redfish-compatible, delivering millisecond thermal response plus real-time telemetry and analytics. Phononic publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; technical access runs through sales and customer support.

providers.name: Barakah
providers.description: Barakah is a Saudi foodtech company operating a consumer mobile marketplace that fights food waste by connecting restaurants, cafes, hotels, bakeries, and grocery retailers with consumers who buy their surplus, still-fresh meals and food products at discounts of up to 70 percent for pickup or delivery. Founded in Jeddah and backed by 500 Global, FoodLabs, and Salica Investments, Barakah has grown into one of the most downloaded food and drink apps in Saudi Arabia with partnerships across more than 800 merchants, including global brands. Barakah is a business-to-consumer mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Cheaf
providers.description: Cheaf is a mobile food-rescue marketplace that connects supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, and food retailers holding surplus inventory with consumers who buy it as discounted "surprise packages" at pickup, cutting food waste while helping merchants recover value on stock that would otherwise be thrown away. Founded in Mexico in 2020, the consumer app operates across Mexico, Chile, and Argentina, has more than 3.5 million users, and reports millions of kilograms of food rescued and greenhouse-gas emissions avoided. Businesses list surplus through a merchant onboarding portal and pay a commission on sales; consumers browse and reserve packages through the mobile app. This API Evangelist profile tracks Cheaf's public web and developer surface; Cheaf is a consumer/merchant mobile platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Condor Energy
providers.description: Condor Energy is an AI-powered energy management operating system for enterprise energy procurement, built for industrial companies, retailers, and data center operators who buy electricity at scale. The platform aggregates consumption data, PPAs, solar, batteries, and live market data into real-time dashboards; models load against market dynamics to execute hedging strategies and produce board-ready price-risk reporting; and analyzes granular load data to find flexibility opportunities and evaluate ROI on solar, battery, EV-charging, and hybrid investments. Founded in 2026 by former electricity traders and energy physicists, the Paris-based company is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Grover
providers.description: Grover is a Berlin-based consumer technology rental and subscription company that lets people rent smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles, cameras, smart home devices, and audio gear on flexible monthly plans ranging from one to twenty-four-plus months. With more than 500,000 active renters across the United States, Germany, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands, Grover positions flexible tech access as a circular, subscription-based alternative to ownership, refurbishing and recirculating returned devices for resale. Grover is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hemster
providers.description: Hemster is a fashion-technology company that modernizes tailoring and garment fit through a digital "Fit Profile" system. Customers create a personalized fit pattern once, then match any garment — new or from their existing closet — to that saved profile so it can be tailored to their perfect fit rather than to a standard size. The platform aims to reduce returns, extend the life of clothing people already own, and remove size-related hesitation at purchase, with a sustainability angle around keeping garments out of landfill. Hemster operates a consumer web app at my.hemster.co and a related returns/deadstock product ((re)vive / byrevive.com). It is backed by Bullpen Capital. As of this profile Hemster publishes no public developer, API, or integration surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Material Bank
providers.description: Material Bank is a B2B digital marketplace that lets architects, interior designers, and other design professionals search, sample, and specify building and design materials from 650+ brands across hundreds of categories through a single platform, with free overnight sample delivery. The platform provides project boards, brand collections, sustainability filters (EPDs, CDPH), and a manufacturer portal for brands. Backed by bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Smol
providers.description: Smol is a UK-based direct-to-consumer home-care brand founded in 2018 by Paula Quazi and Nick Green, delivering concentrated, plant-based, cruelty-free cleaning products — laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, fabric conditioner, surface sprays and personal-care bars — on a flexible subscription that ships refills through the letterbox. The company positions itself as a sustainability challenger to legacy home-care brands, emphasizing reduced plastic, carbon and chemical load, and became a certified B Corporation in July 2022. Backed by Balderton Capital and GV, Smol operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription business; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer program.

providers.name: Bevi
providers.description: Bevi is a smart beverage-dispenser company that manufactures connected, filtered-water machines for offices and commercial spaces. Its IoT-enabled Standup and Countertop dispensers deliver still and sparkling water plus dozens of fruit flavors and functional enhancements (vitamins, electrolytes, energy, focus), connect directly to a building's water supply, and track plastic bottles saved in real time. Bevi is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Techstars, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API surface (OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal) was found during enrichment; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Forge Nano
providers.description: Forge Nano is a materials-technology manufacturer headquartered in Thornton, Colorado that commercializes particle and wafer Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) under its Atomic Armor platform and patented ALDx architecture. The company applies atomic-scale nanocoatings to powders, electrodes and semiconductor wafers to improve energy density, cycle life, thermal stability and yield, and sells three lines of business: US-sourced lithium-ion cells from its Morrisville, North Carolina gigafactory, commercial semiconductor wafer-fabrication equipment including the TEPHRA cluster tool for 200mm wafers, and Powder ALD coating systems for batteries, catalysts and composites. Its markets are semiconductors, energy storage, defense and aerospace, AI hardware and quantum devices. Forge Nano is a hardware and advanced-materials company: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Presso
providers.description: Presso is a garment-care automation company (operated by parent LaundrySucks.io Inc.) that builds robotic, AI-driven systems for dry cleaning and laundry businesses. Its flagship AirTouch product is a compact, plug-and-play unit that runs on a standard 110V outlet and combines automatic fabric recognition, built-in non-toxic cleaning formulas, and smart temperature control to deliver same-day wash, fold, and dry cleaning under one roof. Presso positions itself around faster, greener, and gentler garment care without compressors, boilers, or skilled labor. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Presso publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface — it is a hardware/robotics and equipment business, not an API provider.

providers.name: Root Global
providers.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: The Atlas Marketplace
providers.description: The Atlas Marketplace (branded "The Atlas") is a free online community and knowledge marketplace for local government leaders. Officials and staff use it to learn from their peers about the smart, safe, and sustainable solutions working in their communities, browsing a searchable library of case studies, vendors, and civic-technology projects. The platform connects public-sector practitioners with the companies and partners behind proven municipal solutions across mobility, infrastructure, sustainability, and public safety. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a content and community website rather than a developer/API product; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Avathon
providers.description: Avathon — formerly SparkCognition, rebranded in November 2024 — is an industrial AI company whose Industrial AI Platform combines a data platform, industrial digital twin, AI modeling and application development layers to bring predictive maintenance, asset performance management, visual intelligence and autonomy to physical operations. Its solutions span renewables, oil and gas, power and utilities, manufacturing, mining, aerospace and defense, maritime, rail, aviation, logistics, warehousing and retail, with named offerings including Asset Performance Management, Visual AI / Visual Intelligence, Autonomy for Health, Safety and Environment, the Digital Maintenance Advisor and the Multidomain Awareness Advisor. The platform is sold and delivered as an enterprise engagement — marketing material references an application development SDK and APIs, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published; the only documentation surface, support.avathon.com/help, redirects to a HubSpot member login. Avathon is backed by investors including Temasek, Verizon Ventures and Boeing, and is headquartered in Silicon Valley after relocating from Austin, Texas.

providers.name: Battery Smart
providers.description: Battery Smart is India's largest battery-swapping network for electric two- and three-wheelers, founded in 2019 by Pulkit Khurana and Siddharth Sikka and operated from New Delhi by Upgrid Solutions Private Limited and Upgrid Electrilease Private Limited. It runs an asset-light, partner-led model: local businesses — kirana stores, petrol pumps and neighbourhood shops — host swap points where a driver exchanges a depleted lithium-ion pack for a charged one in roughly two minutes and pays per swap instead of buying the battery with the vehicle, which removes the single largest cost from an electric two- or three-wheeler. The network is concentrated in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jaipur and Lucknow, and the company has raised across eleven rounds including a USD 65 million Series B led by LeapFrog Investments with MUFG Bank, Panasonic, Ecosystem Integrity Fund, Blume Ventures and British International Investment participating, plus a USD 15 million debt round with Mirova in April 2026. Battery Smart's software ships only as end-user Android applications — Battery Smart Driver and Battery Smart Partner — backed by a production API host at api.upgrid.in that self-identifies as the "Battery Smart API". As of this profile the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Choose Energy
providers.description: Choose Energy is a free online energy marketplace, founded in 2008 and operated by Red Ventures, that helps consumers and businesses in deregulated U.S. energy markets compare electricity and natural gas plans, view transparent all-inclusive pricing, and switch providers online in minutes. The platform serves customers across Texas, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and other deregulated states, and also offers solar cost estimation, business energy procurement, and educational energy resources. Choose Energy is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: La Solive
providers.description: La Solive is a French vocational training organization (organisme de formation) preparing career-changers and apprentices for the trades behind building energy renovation and the climate transition. It runs state-recognized, practice-based programs — chef de projet en rénovation énergétique, conducteur de travaux, plombier chauffagiste pompe à chaleur et gaz, technicien de maintenance CVC, installateur de panneaux photovoltaïques, QualiPAC and agent de maintenance du bâtiment — delivered across campuses in Paris, Lyon, Nantes, Marseille, Toulouse and Lille plus a distance-learning track, with Qualiopi certification and France Travail / Mon Compte Formation / Transitions Pro financing. La Solive reports 1,500+ students trained and 500+ recruiting partner companies. It is a Partech portfolio company in the Climate sector. As of this enrichment pass La Solive publishes no public API, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; it does publish an /llms.txt agent-readable site index, captured in this repo.

providers.name: MoveYou
providers.description: Our scaled based platform meets all your business requirements in the fields of mobility and energy. Explore the powerful solutions or consult one of our experts for advice. Together, we are building a sustainable future for your organization.

providers.name: Ohmium
providers.description: Ohmium International designs, manufactures and deploys modular, vertically-stackable proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer systems for cost-competitive green hydrogen production. Its Lotus PEM electrolyzer platform integrates power electronics, water treatment and controls into skid-mounted modules for industrial, energy and mobility customers, and is paired with EPC and remote monitoring and maintenance (RM&M) services. Ohmium is a hardware and clean-energy engineering company: it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its customer-facing monitoring and service portals are third-party SaaS products hosted on Ohmium subdomains behind login.

providers.name: StoreDot
providers.description: StoreDot is an Israeli battery technology company founded in 2012 by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn and Gil Rosenman, headquartered in Herzliya with an advanced technology campus in Irvine, California. It develops extreme fast charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells built on proprietary silicon-dominant anode chemistry and synthesized organic and inorganic compounds optimized with machine-learning models, targeting the range and charging anxiety that gate mainstream electric-vehicle adoption. Its "100inX" product roadmap sets 100 miles of range charged in 5 minutes (100in5, 2024), 3 minutes (100in3, 2028) and 2 minutes (100in2, 2032); the company has demonstrated pouch and prismatic XFC cells sustaining more than 1,000 and later 2,000 extreme fast charging cycles while retaining over 80 percent of original capacity, and designs its chemistry to drop into existing Li-ion production lines. Strategic investors and partners include Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, BP, VinFast, Volvo, Polestar, Ola Electric, Samsung Ventures, TDK and manufacturing partner EVE Energy. In 2026 a planned SPAC merger with Andretti Acquisition Corp. II was terminated and the company returned to private fundraising. StoreDot is a hardware, materials and cell-manufacturing business: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server or machine-readable API contract, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, llms.txt or developer subdomain resolves on store-dot.com.

providers.name: ZeroAvia
providers.description: ZeroAvia is a UK/US hydrogen-electric aviation company founded in 2017 by Valery Miftakhov, developing hydrogen fuel cell and electric propulsion systems for commercial aircraft. Its powertrain line runs from the ZA600 (600kW, 10-20 seat regional turboprops) through the ZA2000 (2-5MW, 40-80 seat turboprops) to the ZA2000 RJ (5MW+, up to 90 seat regional jets), alongside a component business selling electric propulsion systems, inverters, electric motors and HTPEM/SuperStack fuel cell stacks to other clean-aviation manufacturers, plus a hydrogen airport refuelling ecosystem of electrolyzers, mobile refuelers and LH2 development. It operates from Cotswold Airport in Kemble, UK and from Everett, Washington, and holds FAA and CAA experimental certificates for its flight-test aircraft. ZeroAvia sells certified aerospace hardware to airframers, airlines, lessors and defense customers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: Aerospacelab
providers.description: Aerospacelab is a vertically integrated satellite manufacturer headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, founded in 2018 by Benoit Deper. The company designs, builds, tests and operates small-to-medium satellites — its Versatile Satellite Platform (VSP-50, VSP-150, VSP-300) family plus mission-specific payloads spanning very-high-resolution and multispectral/hyperspectral Earth observation, synthetic aperture radar, radio-frequency sensing, and narrowband/broadband telecommunications — for commercial, institutional and government customers, with an explicitly ITAR-free European supply chain. It is roughly 90% vertically integrated across platforms, payloads, avionics and subsystems, has flown eight satellites in under three years, acquired Belgian space-optics firm AMOS, and is building a European satellite megafactory targeting 500 satellites per year. Aerospacelab publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its programmatic surfaces (mission control, tasking, image-processing pipeline and data platform built under the ESA InCubed MultiSpectral Companion Mission) are delivered to contracted mission customers rather than to self-serve developers.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Cowboy Space Corporation (formerly Aetherflux)
providers.description: Cowboy Space Corporation is an American orbital-infrastructure company founded in 2024 by Baiju Bhatt, co-founder and former co-CEO of Robinhood, headquartered in San Carlos, California with a second site in Seattle, Washington. It operated as Aetherflux Inc. from founding until May 2026, when it renamed to Cowboy Space Corporation and broadened its mission from space-based solar power alone to vertically integrated orbital infrastructure for the AI era, spanning launch vehicles, space-based power generation and in-orbit compute. Its flagship program is Stampede, a Low Earth Orbit constellation of satellites that harvest solar power to run on-orbit GPU data centers, with the first Galactic Brain data-center node targeted for early 2027 using NVIDIA Space-1 Vera Rubin modules and a small infrared power-beaming demonstrator satellite planned for 2026. The company concluded that launch supply was the binding constraint on orbital compute and is therefore also developing its own rocket, sized between Falcon 9 and Starship at roughly 20,000-25,000 kg of payload, whose upper stage is itself the payload - each one intended to become a one-megawatt orbital data center - with a first launch targeted for the end of 2028. It has raised roughly USD 365 million to date, including a USD 50 million Series A in April 2025 and a USD 275 million Series B in May 2026 at a USD 2 billion valuation, led by Index Ventures with IVP, Blossom Capital, SAIC, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA and Interlagos participating. Cowboy Space is a space hardware and energy infrastructure company, not a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK, no public GitHub organization and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its entire public web presence is a four-page Framer-hosted marketing site (home, terms, privacy, media terms of use) plus an Ashby-hosted careers board.

providers.name: Cur8
providers.description: CUR8 is a carbon removal intelligence platform based in Oxford, United Kingdom, building the global market for high-quality carbon removals with a mission to remove one billion tonnes of carbon a year. Founded in 2021 by Mark Stevenson, Marta Krupinska and Gabrielle Walker, CUR8 combines financial and scientific expertise to source, evaluate and manage diversified carbon removal portfolios spanning nature restoration, biochar, direct air capture, enhanced weathering, superpollutant abatement and sustainable aviation fuel. Its platform surfaces (Discover for sourcing removal assets, Manage for tracking portfolio performance and risk, Finance for capital provision, and the Carbon Planner for strategy) help enterprises invest in carbon impact with confidence on the path to net zero. Clients include Microsoft, Coca-Cola HBC, Standard Chartered, Arup and UBS. CUR8 is backed by Google Ventures (GV) and Airbus Ventures. No public API, SDK or developer program is advertised as of this profile; access is via the CUR8 dashboard and platform.

providers.name: Grove
providers.description: Grove (Grove Collaborative) is a direct-to-consumer retailer of everyday household essentials for a healthier home and planet, including eco-friendly cleaning products, bamboo paper products, personal care, and vitamins & supplements sourced from hundreds of vetted brands alongside its own private labels. Orders are held to strict ingredient standards, are carbon neutral, and support plastic-waste cleanup. The business runs as a subscription-friendly e-commerce storefront (hosted on Shopify). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Grove operates a consumer retail storefront and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its identity and web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: The House Of LR&C
providers.description: The House of LR&C (Love, Respect & Care) is a Seattle-based, mission-driven direct-to-consumer fashion company founded in 2020 by Russell Wilson, Ciara, and retail veteran Christine Day. A Certified B Corporation, it operates a portfolio of apparel brands including Good Man Brand, LITA by Ciara, and Human Nation, donating 3% of net revenue to the Why Not You Foundation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public commerce runs on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. The only machine-readable surface on the storefront host is Shopify's platform-level Customer Account API OIDC discovery document.

providers.name: Thea Energy
providers.description: Thea Energy, Inc. is a fusion energy company headquartered in Kearny, New Jersey, founded in 2022 on stellarator physics and engineering developed at Princeton University and the Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory. Thea is reinventing the stellarator by replacing complex, hand-wound 3D modular coils with a phased array of simple planar electromagnetic coils, moving the complexity of shaping the magnetic field out of the hardware and into a software control stack that can be tuned over an asset's lifetime. Its first integrated machine, Eos, is a steady-state, neutron-producing stellarator; the follow-on Helios is intended to be an electricity-producing plant. The company raised a $100M Series B in May 2026 led by Thomas Tull's US Innovative Technology Fund, and the U.S. Department of Energy has certified its power plant preconceptual design milestone. Thea publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract; its only public software surface is a small set of open-source nuclear-engineering and simulation libraries on GitHub.

providers.name: Vital Lyfe
providers.description: Vital Lyfe is a Torrance, California hardware company building portable water purification technology designed to scale where infrastructure cannot reach. Its flagship product, Access, is a portable watermaker that converts naturally occurring water, including saltwater, into clean drinking water through a simple place-a-hose, press-start, hydrate workflow. The company sells the Access device and branded gear through a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront and publishes a mission, team, careers, and journal. It was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Vital Lyfe is a consumer-hardware and e-commerce brand with no public API, SDK, or developer program surface.

providers.name: actnano
providers.description: actnano, Inc. is a Massachusetts-based advanced materials company that develops and manufactures PFAS-free protective nanocoatings for electronics. Its flagship Advanced nanoGUARD technology is a gel-state, 100% fluorine-free conformal coating applied to printed circuit board assemblies, connectors, antennas, LEDs and high-heat-generating components, delivering up to IPx8 moisture and condensation protection without trapping heat or degrading signal integrity. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a Munich center of excellence and operations in Mexico and Japan, actnano serves mobility and automotive electronics, consumer electronics, AI and data-center infrastructure, solar, industrial electronics, medical devices and optical anti-fog applications. The company states REACH and RoHS compliance and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is backed by BMW i Ventures, Porsche Ventures and Emerald Technology Ventures. actnano is a materials manufacturer: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Carbon Direct
providers.description: Carbon Direct is a science-first carbon management company that pairs an enterprise carbon management platform with a team of 70+ scientists. The platform helps organizations measure emissions, set science-based targets, reduce, and procure high-quality carbon dioxide removal (CDR), with monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) capabilities expanded through its 2025 acquisition of Pachama. Carbon Direct is an enterprise SaaS and advisory offering and does not publish a public developer API as of this profile.

providers.name: Geltor
providers.description: Geltor is a biodesign company founded in 2015 by Alex Lorestani and Nick Ouzounov that engineers animal-free designer proteins, peptides and polypeptides and manufactures them through precision fermentation. Its Biodesigner AI computational biology platform is used to imagine, screen and optimize novel protein sequences, which are then scaled commercially as ingredients for beauty and personal care, specialty nutrition and medical/life-science applications. The portfolio includes HumaColl 21 (biomimetic human collagen), HumaColl 21 Select (a matrikine peptide complex), Elastapure (biomimetic human elastin), Collume and Caviance (vegan collagens) and PrimaColl, a Type XXI signaling collagen and the first biotech-derived collagen to receive an FDA GRAS "no questions" letter for ingestible use. Geltor sells business-to-business to brand formulators and manufacturers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Republic Services
providers.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

providers.name: Sirius
providers.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.

providers.name: Packhelp
providers.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: ConnectDER
providers.description: ConnectDER is a Philadelphia-based clean energy hardware company and the leading US manufacturer of meter socket adapters (MSAs, also called meter collars) for the residential market. Founded in 2011 as Infinite Invention LLC after a DOE SunShot Incubator grant, it builds plug-and-play devices that install at the utility meter socket to interconnect distributed energy resources — rooftop solar, battery storage and EV charging — without panel upgrades, line-side taps or circuit relocations. Its product line is the IslandDER MSA (a microgrid interconnect device for solar-plus-battery and whole-home backup, integrated by SolarEdge, FranklinWH, Lunar Energy, EcoFlow and Fox ESS), the Solar MSA and the EV MSA. ConnectDER helped author UL 414 Supplements A, B and C, the standards governing meter socket adapters, and has surpassed 40,000 devices installed across US utility territories including PG&E, SCE and SDG&E. ConnectDER publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract; its devices communicate with partner battery systems over discrete hardwired sensing, control and status signals rather than a network interface. It does publish an llms.txt at its web root.

providers.name: Commons
providers.description: Commons is an Oakland, California consumer climate-fintech company founded in 2018 by Sanchali Seth Pal and operated under the name Joro until its March 2023 rebrand. Its free iOS and Android app connects a user's bank accounts and credit cards through Plaid and runs every transaction through a proprietary carbon-estimation engine, the Carbonizer, which translates dollars spent into an estimate of kilograms of CO2e, alongside budgeting, savings goals, expert-reviewed sustainable brand ratings, a rewards program, monthly community challenges and an optional paid offset membership. The company has raised roughly USD 13.9 million across three rounds from investors including Sequoia Capital and Amasia. Commons is a direct-to-consumer mobile product rather than an API vendor: thecommons.earth is a Webflow marketing site with no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract, its brand directory and member exchange run on Next.js and Softr respectively, and its only public GitHub organization, CommonsTech, holds a single 2023 repository publishing carbon-offset provider evaluations rather than code.

providers.name: Redwood Materials
providers.description: Redwood Materials is a Carson City, Nevada battery materials company founded in 2017 by former Tesla CTO JB Straubel. It operates a domestic circular supply chain for lithium-ion batteries: collecting and recycling end-of-life EV, consumer, micromobility and stationary-storage batteries, refining the recovered lithium, nickel, cobalt and copper, and remanufacturing anode copper foil and cathode active material for North American cell producers. Through Redwood Energy it also deploys second-life battery energy storage systems for data centers and the grid. Redwood runs the Tahoe Campus in Northern Nevada, the Carolina Campus outside Charleston, South Carolina, and an R&D center in San Francisco, and works with Panasonic, Toyota, GM, BMW, VW/Audi, Rivian, Caterpillar, Isuzu and Lime. Redwood publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK or MCP server; its only machine-facing surface is a gated AWS Cognito partner portal used by automotive dismantlers to price and sell end-of-life battery packs.

providers.name: ThredUp
providers.description: ThredUp (NASDAQ: TDUP) is one of the world's largest online resale and consignment platforms for secondhand women's and kids' clothing, shoes, and accessories. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Oakland, CA, it lets consumers buy and sell pre-owned fashion via mailed Clean Out Kits, and powers branded recommerce for 60+ retailers through its Resale-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform. ThredUp does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; RaaS integrations are arranged through its partner sales team, so this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, engineering, and policy surface rather than a documented API program.

providers.name: Aalo Atomics
providers.description: Aalo Atomics is an Austin, Texas-based advanced nuclear engineering company, founded in 2021, working to make reactor deployment fast, repeatable, and economical through factory manufacturing. It is developing the Aalo-1, a factory-fabricated sodium-cooled microreactor (~10 MWe class), and Aalo Pod power plants that combine five Aalo-1 reactors to deliver roughly 50 megawatts of electricity for data centers, industrial facilities, and communities. The company describes a new XMR ("extra modular reactor") category, has raised a $100M Series B, and is advancing through U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission pre-application activities and a U.S. Department of Energy experimental microreactor site in Idaho.
