providers.description: Cylib is a German battery recycling company founded in 2022 as a spinoff from RWTH Aachen University, headquartered in Aachen, Germany. It transforms end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, and black mass back into critical raw materials, recovering lithium, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese through a proprietary, largely water-based hydrometallurgical process that the company reports achieves over 90% recycling efficiency with an ~80% reduced carbon footprint versus primary extraction, powered by 100% renewable electricity. The company is backed by Speedinvest and other investors. Cylib operates as an industrial cleantech / circular-economy materials business and does not currently publish a developer program, public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software integration surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and carries only identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Enough
providers.description: ENOUGH (brand name ABUNDA) is a food-technology company that produces mycoprotein through a zero-waste fermentation process, growing fungi on grain-derived sugars. Operating as a B2B ingredient supplier to retailers and food brands, ENOUGH makes nutrient-dense, sustainable meat and seafood alternatives — including burgers, chicken-style products, noodles, and snacks — that use dramatically less water and produce far less CO2 than conventional animal protein. The company operates one of the world's largest mycoprotein fermentation facilities and is backed by DCVC. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; ENOUGH is a food-ingredient business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Everdrop
providers.description: Everdrop is a Munich-based direct-to-consumer sustainability brand, founded in 2019, that sells more sustainable everyday household products — cleaning tabs, laundry detergent, dishwasher tablets, washing-up liquid and natural body care — designed around a refill model of concentrated tabs/powders dissolved in reusable bottles to cut single-use plastic, unnecessary chemicals and CO2. The company operates an e-commerce storefront (Shopify/Next.js/Storyblok stack) with a subscription-based refill program, and reports certifications including B Corp, EU Ecolabel and Ecocert. It has no public developer or API program; this profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched from Everdrop's public web surface.

providers.name: EVERY Company
providers.description: The EVERY Company (formerly Clara Foods; site now at every.com, redirected from theeverycompany.com) is a foodtech ingredients company that produces animal-free, antibiotic-free egg proteins using precision fermentation. Its flagship OvoPro product replicates the functional properties of conventional eggs — binding, gelling, foaming, and whipping — for food manufacturers making baked goods, frozen foods, pasta, and protein bars, offering kosher, halal, and sustainable ingredients with more consistent pricing and availability than animal-derived eggs. Backed by Prosus Ventures. As a B2B ingredient supplier it publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fibmold
providers.description: Fibmold is an eco-friendly molded-fiber packaging manufacturer building sustainable, plastic-free alternatives to rigid single-use plastic packaging. Its products are thermoformed from natural fibres such as bagasse, bamboo, and hard/soft wood pulp collected from farms, forests, and agro-processing units, then upcycled into compostable and recyclable packaging. Applications span food-service packaging, customised industrial solutions, fibre-based dosing scoops, aviation casseroles, cosmetic inserts, pharma injectable trays, chocolate trays, and noodle cups. Fibmold also runs the Primo by Fibmold retail storefront and builds manufacturing eco-systems and material-science innovation to scale sustainable packaging on the supply side. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Forward Earth
providers.description: Forward Earth is a Berlin-based climate technology company building AI-automated carbon management software that helps businesses measure, track, and reduce their carbon footprint in line with environmental regulation. Its platform covers Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) accounting certified to the GHG Protocol, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) calculation, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) compliance reporting, with an emphasis on automating data collection and emissions calculation to save time and cost. Forward Earth also offers a white-label / partner offering that embeds its carbon management capabilities into GRC, ESG, supply-chain, and consultancy software, exposing environmental and partner-specific APIs plus single sign-on through a sandbox that partners access on request. The company is backed by Speedinvest and is moving toward agent-native product carbon footprinting.

providers.name: Gourmey
providers.description: Gourmey is a Paris-based cultivated meat company producing sustainable, cell-cultured meat delights — starting with cultivated foie gras — for an uncompromising and conscious generation. Founded in France and backed by Partech and Point Nine, Gourmey grows real meat directly from animal cells without raising or slaughtering animals, aiming for a lower environmental footprint across the food and agritech sectors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile; Gourmey operates a consumer and corporate website but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: La Vie
providers.description: La Vie Foods is a Paris-based plant-based food company that makes vegan alternatives to pork products, including bacon, smoked lardons, ham, salami sticks, croquettes and meatballs, sold across French and UK retail and foodservice. Its stated mission is to move people from animal to vegetable fat without compromising on taste, citing 88% less CO2, 82% less water and 74% less land use than conventional pork. Its products are stocked by retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Whole Foods Market and Planet Organic, and used by restaurant partners such as Burger King. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech. La Vie Foods operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI, packages or programmatic API surface, and exposes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures the company's real public web, legal, press and domain-security surface rather than developer artifacts.

providers.name: Makani *
providers.description: Makani was an Alphabet (Google X) moonshot developing airborne wind energy — "energy kites" that flew in crosswind loops to generate electricity and sent power to the grid down a tether. Backed within Alphabet and partnered with Shell, Makani wound down in 2020 after roughly 13 years of development. On closure the team open-sourced its full flight-simulation, autopilot controller, visualization, and avionics software stack under Apache-2.0 and published the Energy Kite Collection of technical reports, designs, and flight logs. Makani has no commercial or developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company for network completeness.

providers.name: Martie
providers.description: Martie is a woman-owned, San Francisco-based online discount grocery marketplace founded in 2021 to fight food waste and make quality goods accessible and affordable. Martie works directly with brands on their overstock, surplus, seasonal, and old-packaging inventory — pantry staples, beauty, and household goods — and resells it to consumers at up to 80% off retail with no membership or subscription required. Shoppers browse daily deals through the martie.com website or the Martie iOS and Android apps. The company reports having diverted over five million pounds of food from landfill since launch. Martie is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched with company identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Mast Reforestation
providers.description: Mast Reforestation (formerly DroneSeed) is North America's leading post-fire reforestation and carbon-removal company, restoring wildfire-damaged forests across the American West. It operates two nurseries, Cal Forest Nurseries and Silvaseed, manages the largest seed bank in the western United States, grows more than 30 million seedlings annually, and develops carbon-removal credits by burying post-wildfire biomass to finance reforestation for landowners and consulting foresters. Mast publishes no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: Momox
providers.description: momox SE (formerly Momox AG / Momox GmbH) is a Berlin-based re-commerce company founded by Christian Wegner in 2004 — the name stands for "Moderner Medien Online Express-Ankauf" (Modern Media Online Express Purchase). Through momox.de it buys used books, CDs, DVDs/Blu-rays and games from private sellers at fixed prices in Germany, Austria, France, Belgium and the UK, reselling them via its Medimops shop and third-party marketplaces. Its momox fashion arm (formerly ubup.com, momoxfashion.com) does the same for second-hand clothing, shoes and accessories. momox runs large logistics centres in Berlin, Leipzig and Neuenhagen bei Berlin and has handled more than 350 million articles since founding. momox is a consumer-facing re-commerce operation; it publishes no official public developer program, API portal, or SDKs. The only machine surface is an internal, undocumented mobile-app pricing endpoint (api.momox.de / api.momox.fr) that is not offered as a first-party API.

providers.name: NCX
providers.description: NCX (Natural Capital Exchange), originally founded as SilviaTerra, is a forestry technology company that maps and measures every acre of U.S. forestland using satellite imagery and machine learning. NCX built the Natural Capital Exchange, a marketplace that paid landowners to defer timber harvests and generate forest carbon credits, and it now offers LandBook, a tool that helps landowners capture the story, plans, and practical knowledge behind their property so it can be passed on to the next steward. The company is backed by Union Square Ventures and Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Nexii
providers.description: Nexii is a green construction technology company that designs and manufactures prefabricated wall and roof panel systems for commercial and industrial buildings. Its panels are made from Nexiite, a proprietary low-carbon building material the company says is up to 80% lighter than conventional concrete, and bolt together on site to cut build times by as much as five times while producing near-zero construction waste. Nexii serves retail, residential, warehouse, data center, cold storage, healthcare, office and education verticals, with projects for Starbucks, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, Popeyes, Dutch Bros, Walmart and Marriott. The original Vancouver-based Nexii Building Solutions entered creditor protection in January 2024; Dallas-based 3 Gates acquired its assets in a court-approved sale completed 28 June 2024 and relaunched the business as NEXII, Inc., headquartered in Dallas, Texas with manufacturing in Squamish, British Columbia. Nucor Corporation subsequently made a strategic equity investment. Nexii is a manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Omnitron Sensors
providers.description: Omnitron Sensors designs advanced MEMS (micro electro mechanical systems) sensors using innovative 3D manufacturing techniques, aiming to deliver high-performance, low-cost sensing with major gains in precision and reliability. Its technology targets AI data centers, autonomous systems and vehicles, environmental and climate monitoring, and extended reality (XR) devices. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the company is a hardware/semiconductor business with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: One Five
providers.description: One Five (styled one.five) is a sustainable packaging technology company based in Holm, Germany that pairs an AI-driven decision platform, Quartermaster, with ready-to-use recyclable and compostable packaging products. The Quartermaster platform embeds product-market-fit and material analysis into packaging development to accelerate material scouting and packing trials, helping consumer brands cut R&D spend, improve customer acquisition efficiency, and meet emerging packaging regulations while reducing environmental impact. One Five ships flexible sustainable packaging for categories such as dishwasher tablets and gummies through partners including Bluemorph and Glassleaf, and is backed by Speedinvest. The company offers no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Orchard Labs
providers.description: Orchard Labs Inc. is a Toronto-based e-commerce company, founded in 2013, that buys, refurbishes, and resells pre-owned and certified-refurbished smartphones, tablets, and accessories across North America. Through its consumer website and mobile app, Orchard lets people test, price, and sell their used iPhones and Android devices, and buy thoroughly tested refurbished devices backed by a 90-day no-questions-asked warranty and carbon-neutral shipping. It is a consumer retail brand with no public API, developer portal, or SDKs. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: PierSight Space
providers.description: PierSight Space is an India-based space technology company building a constellation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Automatic Identification System (AIS) satellites for persistent, all-weather maritime surveillance of the world's oceans. Founded by former ISRO engineer Gaurav Seth, PierSight delivers near-real-time ocean monitoring (targeting ~30-minute data latency and 100% ocean coverage) to detect illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing, monitor oil spills, protect Exclusive Economic Zones, support maritime insurance risk assessment, and improve shipping operations. The company has raised roughly $8M from investors including Alpha Wave Ventures, Elevation Capital, and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass PierSight sells data solutions to enterprise and government clients and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Raus
providers.description: Raus (operated by StayRaus GmbH, Berlin) is a consumer platform for booking sustainable, design-forward tiny cabins in nature across Germany and Austria, giving city dwellers a quick escape "close to home." Guests browse and book fully-equipped smart cabins in forests, by lakes, and on farms, add culinary experiences and extras, buy gift cards, and can list their own land as a host. Raus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2C hospitality/booking brand with a public consumer website but no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Recycleye
providers.description: Recycleye is a London-based company building AI-powered sorting equipment and analytics for waste management and material recovery businesses worldwide. Its products include Recycleye QualiBot robotic sorting cells, Recycleye QuantiSort optical sorting technology, and Recycleye Insights, a data analytics platform that uses computer vision (WasteNet) to identify and categorize waste streams. The company sells hardware and software into recycling operations to improve purity, recovery rates, and profitability. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC. As of this enrichment pass Recycleye publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Renoster Systems
providers.description: Renoster Systems is a carbon-credit ratings agency bringing deep transparency to the nature-based voluntary carbon markets. Using remote sensing, LiDAR, satellite data, and machine learning, Renoster independently rates forestry and other nature-based carbon offset projects, quantifying how much CO2 per credit a project has actually sequestered, and publishes public tools such as its Mercury project database and Renoster/Mercury rubric for researchers, reserve managers, policymakers, and corporate buyers. Renoster is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: ResourceWise
providers.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

providers.name: WINT
providers.description: WINT (also styled Wint) is an AI-powered water management and leak-detection platform for commercial and industrial facilities. Its IoT flow sensors, automated shut-off valves, and 24/7 staffed monitoring center use signal processing and anomaly detection to catch leaks in real time across main feeds, domestic cold and hot water, HVAC loops, cooling towers, and irrigation systems, reporting 20-25% average water-consumption reduction and up to 90% less water damage and insurance loss. WINT is backed by Insight Partners and carries NSF International, ISO, and USGBC affiliations. During enrichment no public developer API, documentation, well-known discovery surface, OpenAPI, or SDK was found; this profile captures the company's public web properties and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Equilibrium Energy
providers.description: Equilibrium Energy is a venture-backed clean energy technology company building PowerOS, an agentic AI platform for the power and energy sector. The platform is designed to solve the extreme data and systems fragmentation across the power tech stack, uniting enterprise data, models, and systems under a common ontology and code frameworks so that power companies can deploy power-specific AI with guardrails they control. PowerOS bundles enterprise agents (trader and research copilots, app co-developers, data ingestion and transformation), configurable application suites (portfolio management, portfolio construction, development workbenches, middle and back office), and reusable core services (optimization, forecasting, risk, grid and market fundamentals, trading). The company's Mission Control product is in invite-only beta. Equilibrium Energy is backed by DCVC and is headquartered in the United States. It currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, news, and organization surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Solfacil
providers.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.

providers.name: UBQ Materials
providers.description: UBQ Materials is a climate-tech company founded in 2012 that converts unsorted mixed household waste, including organics and hard-to-recycle plastics, into UBQ, a climate-positive thermoplastic material that substitutes for oil-based plastics in manufacturing. A Certified B Corporation backed by Battery Ventures, the company operates a full-scale production facility in Bergen op Zoom, Netherlands (opened 2024) with 80,000 tons of annual capacity, plus an R&D center in Tze'elim, Israel. UBQ Materials publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Verdagy
providers.description: Verdagy is a Moss Landing, California clean-energy hardware company that designs and manufactures dynamic alkaline water electrolysis systems for large-scale green hydrogen production. Its eDynamic platform runs very large-area membrane-based electrochemical cells at high current density with dynamic turndown, so electrolyzers can follow intermittent renewable power, targeting fossil-fuel cost parity for clean hydrogen by 2028 without subsidies. The company operates a 2 MW eDynamic demonstration plant at Moss Landing with more than 21,000 commercial cell hours, plus 500 kW and 100 kW test plants, and opened a DOE-supported gigawatt-scale manufacturing facility of more than 100,000 square feet in Newark, California. Verdagy sells electrolyzer hardware and project capacity to industrial hydrogen buyers — refining, ammonia, methanol, e-fuels and SAF — rather than software; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: BlueLayer
providers.description: BlueLayer is an operating-system platform for carbon-project developers, providing infrastructure to collect project data, run automated digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV), manage the carbon-credit lifecycle from estimation through retirement, and generate revenue by distributing and selling credits while reducing compliance burden. The product spans project operations, a revenue engine, credit management, a stakeholder DataHub, customizable dashboards, and integrations with registries, CRMs, accounting software, and ERPs. Backed by Point Nine, BlueLayer was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface was found — the platform is accessed via its hosted web application.

providers.name: Fuse Energy
providers.description: Fuse Energy (originally launched as Tesseract) is a UK-based, vertically integrated energy supplier founded by former Revolut executives Alan Chang and Charles Orr. It buys power from generators and supplies gas and electricity directly to residential and business customers, positioning itself to beat the UK price cap with variable, fixed and multi-rate tariffs, 30-minute billing updates, EV charging, solar/battery export tracking and an in-app AI assistant called "Plugs." The company raised $78M led by Balderton Capital and Lakestar. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Fuse Energy publishes only a consumer-facing web and mobile app and no public developer API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Sylvera
providers.description: Sylvera is a London-headquartered carbon data and climate intelligence platform — often described as the "Moody's for the voluntary carbon market" — providing independent ratings, market data, and geospatial analytics that help corporate buyers, investors, project developers, governments, and standards bodies make informed decisions across carbon and commodities markets. Founded in 2020 by Allister Furey and Samuel Gill, Sylvera combines remote sensing, machine learning over satellite imagery and LiDAR-derived biomass data, and on-the-ground project assessment to produce letter-graded ratings (e.g., AA, A, B) for carbon credit projects across nature-based (REDD+, ARR, IFM), engineered removals, renewable energy, and cookstove methodologies. The platform's product surface spans Ratings, Market Intelligence (supply, demand, and pricing signals), an Article 6 & CORSIA Hub for compliance risk, a Market Gateway to roughly 400 million tonnes of project inventory, Earth Analytics and a Biomass Atlas for geospatial MRV, and Commodity Insights covering CORSIA, LCFS, CFR, and FuelEU Maritime mechanism eligibility and carbon intensity assessments. Sylvera distributes its data through a web platform, downloadable reports, and a gated Carbon Credit Analytics API (base URL https://api.sylvera.com/v1, JSON API style, API-key auth) used to syndicate ratings and pricing into ESG and sustainability reporting tools such as Workiva, Persefoni, and Watershed. Commercial packaging runs Freemium, Essentials, and Enterprise tiers, with Accelerated Ratings, Market Forecasts, and Geospatial add-ons all sold via contact-sales; there is no public OpenAPI specification, no published SDK, and no Sylvera GitHub organization — the API and full ratings catalog are available only to authenticated enterprise customers.

providers.name: Air Protein
providers.description: Air Protein is a Bay Area food-technology company producing a nutrient-dense, meat-alternative protein made from elements found in the air. Its carbon-conversion fermentation process — derived from NASA closed-loop life-support research — combines carbon dioxide, oxygen, nitrogen, water and renewable energy with hydrogenotrophic microbes to grow a protein flour, which it then transforms into whole-food "air meat" products. Founded by CEO Dr. Lisa Dyson, the company aims to decouple protein production from land and animal agriculture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV; it publishes a marketing site but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Alta Resource Technologies
providers.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

providers.name: Burnbot
providers.description: Burnbot is a wildfire mitigation and fuels management company that builds autonomous, remotely-operated machines and delivers field services to reduce hazardous vegetation and conduct controlled, precision fuel-reduction burns. Its equipment operates in steep, remote, and hazardous terrain around the clock in most weather conditions, cutting fuel loads without disturbing healthy vegetation or compacting soil, and is used across fire hazard mitigation, systematic fuels management, and timber operations. Burnbot works with utilities, transportation agencies, land managers, and tribal governments including PG&E, Caltrans, the U.S. Forest Service, and CAL FIRE. Burnbot was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a hardware and field-services company with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Collectiv Food
providers.description: Collectiv Food is a next-generation B2B food wholesaler serving professional kitchens across the UK and France. Launched in London in 2022, it combines collective buying power, consolidated deliveries, and direct sourcing through a shortened, patented supply-chain model to supply restaurants, hotels, and caterers with meat, fish, plant-based proteins, dairy, produce, dry and frozen goods, and prepared items. The company emphasizes traceability, responsible sourcing, and sustainability, and is B-Corp certified with an EcoVadis Gold rating. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Endless West
providers.description: Endless West is a Detroit-based molecular spirits manufacturer that applies food and molecular science to create alcoholic beverages without traditional distilling or aging. The company operates a TTB-approved production facility offering bulk base spirits and ready-to-bottle liquids, turnkey and private-label packaged brands, pre-made concentrates, and contract co-packing and bottling services for other brands and entrepreneurs. Its proprietary Glyph Molecular Spirit showcases a sustainability approach that reduces water usage and CO2 footprint versus conventional distillation. Endless West is a consumer-products and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: EnerGaia
providers.description: EnerGaia is a spirulina producer, incorporated in Thailand in April 2009 and now headquartered in Singapore, that grows nutrient-dense microalgae in proprietary closed bioreactors rather than open ponds to deliver clean, consistent spirulina for food and beverage manufacturers. The company originated from research into using microalgae to capture industrial CO2 from power-plant flue gas and has since focused on making spirulina a mainstream, sustainable food ingredient. Its product line includes Fresh Spirulina Paste, Fresh-Frozen Spirulina, and Freeze-Dried Spirulina Powder, used in beverages, egg substitutes, noodles, meat replacements, pastas, and snacks. EnerGaia is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Flashfood
providers.description: Flashfood is a Toronto-based mobile marketplace that connects shoppers with heavily discounted groceries nearing their best-by date at partner grocery stores across the United States and Canada. Through its iOS and Android apps, shoppers browse deals of up to 50% off on fresh produce, meat, dairy, and packaged goods, pay in-app, and pick the items up at a dedicated Flashfood Zone in-store. By routing surplus food away from landfills and onto dinner tables, the company reduces grocery-retail food waste while helping families save on their grocery bills. Flashfood is a consumer-facing app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: Mission Barns
providers.description: Mission Barns is a Berkeley, California cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 that grows real animal fat from cells to make animal-friendly pork products — including meatballs, bacon, pepperoni, chorizo, and sausage — built on Mission Fat, its proprietary cultivated pork fat. It is the first company to receive both FDA and USDA clearance for cultivated fat and operates a dual B2C consumer-brand and B2B ingredient / co-development model across foodservice and CPG partners. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-company lead (backed by Point Nine); the company runs a consumer marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Public Goods
providers.description: Public Goods is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer selling household essentials, personal care, and home products under its own private label, with an emphasis on natural formulations, simplified ingredient lists, minimalist packaging, and sustainable sourcing. The company operates a membership model (an annual fee unlocking member pricing, free shipping, and store credit) and a wholesale channel. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Simplifyber
providers.description: Simplifyber is a sustainable footwear and materials technology company that manufactures shoe uppers and other components using a proprietary fiber-molding process. By casting products directly from a liquid, cellulose-based material it eliminates the spinning, weaving, and knitting steps and much of the cutting and sewing of traditional shoemaking, which it says lowers the CO2 emissions of a shoe upper by roughly 33x versus conventional methods. Its flagship Moon Shoe was developed with the fashion brand Ganni. Simplifyber is a Techstars-backed startup. It operates as a consumer and industrial manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: smol
providers.description: smol (smol.com, formerly reachable via smolproducts.com) is a UK-based Certified B Corporation direct-to-consumer home cleaning brand founded in 2018 by ex-Unilever product leaders. It sells concentrated, eco-conscious laundry capsules, dishwasher tablets, and household cleaning products on a letterbox subscription model designed to cut plastic, carbon, and chemical waste. smol runs a consumer e-commerce storefront and a Zendesk help centre only; enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, webhooks, or agent/MCP surface.

providers.name: Stockeld Dreamery
providers.description: Stockeld Dreamery is a Swedish food-tech company founded in Stockholm in early 2019 by Sorosh Tavakoli (previously founder of the video-advertising company Videoplaza) to reinvent animal-based staples as plant-based alternatives, starting with cheese. The company develops and manufactures fermented, legume-based cultured cheese products — including a cream cheese and a melting cheese aimed at foodservice — as a sustainable substitute for dairy. Backed by venture investors including Creandum and Northzone, Stockeld Dreamery operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Sunrun
providers.description: Sunrun is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sunrun API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: BlueNalu
providers.description: BlueNalu, Inc. is a San Diego, California cellular aquaculture company founded in 2017 by Lou Cooperhouse, Chris Somogyi and Chris Dammann that produces cell-cultivated seafood — real seafood grown directly from fish cells rather than harvested from the ocean. Its lead product is cell-cultivated bluefin tuna toro, marketed as "Seafood Without Compromise", targeted first at premium foodservice operators in the United States and then internationally. The company has raised approximately $84 million to date, including a Series B and a December 2025 insider-led convertible note and preferred stock financing led by Agronomics, Siddhi Capital and Lewis & Clark AgriFood, and was the first cell-cultivated seafood company admitted to the National Fisheries Institute. BlueNalu is a food and biotechnology producer; it publishes a marketing website and no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Crown Holdings
providers.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.

providers.name: Axalta Coating Systems
providers.description: Axalta Coating Systems is a global supplier of liquid and powder coatings for transportation and industrial end-markets, operating through Performance Coatings (refinish and industrial) and Mobility Coatings (light vehicle and commercial vehicle) segments. Brands include Cromax, Spies Hecker, Standox, Imron, and Voltatex. In July 2024 Axalta acquired The CoverFlexx Group from Transtar Holding for $285 million to expand its economy-tier aftermarket coverage in North America. In November 2025 Axalta announced a $17 billion all-stock merger of equals with AkzoNobel that is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, forming a coatings company with dual headquarters in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.

providers.name: Schüttflix
providers.description: Schüttflix is a Gütersloh, Germany based digital logistics platform for the construction industry, describing itself as the first digital logistics hub to connect construction companies, building-material suppliers, disposal companies and carriers. The marketplace digitizes the full workflow from ordering bulk materials (sand, gravel, crushed stone) through transport dispatch to the delivery note, and adds construction-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling services. Schüttflix operates as a neutral marketplace ("we don't compete, we connect") spanning 4,000+ suppliers and disposers, 6,800+ partner carriers and 33,000+ vehicles, delivered primarily through native iOS and Android apps rather than a public API. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Steel Dynamics
providers.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is one of the largest domestic steel producers and metals recyclers in the United States, with operations spanning steel manufacturing, steel processing, and metals recycling. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, the company operates steel mills, fabrication operations, and metals recycling facilities. Steel Dynamics is a Fortune 500 company listed on NASDAQ (STLD) and does not offer public developer APIs; data access is available through financial data providers and investor relations communications.

providers.name: SunEdison
providers.description: SunEdison was a renewable energy company that developed, financed, installed, owned, and operated solar power plants and wind energy plants globally. Originally founded as MEMC Electronic Materials in 1959, SunEdison became the world's leading renewable energy developer before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2016 and emerging as a restructured private company in 2017. No public developer API was documented.

providers.name: 6K
providers.description: 6K Inc is a North Andover, Massachusetts advanced-materials company that produces engineered powders and battery materials with UniMelt, its patented microwave-based production-scale plasma system. Named for the roughly 6,000 K plasma temperature it operates at — the temperature of the surface of the sun — UniMelt uses tightly controlled thermal plasma beams to melt or vaporize precursor feedstock into particles with precise size distribution and crystalline phase, in seconds rather than the days conventional processes require, while cutting energy use and eliminating wastewater. The company operates through two divisions. 6K Additive, with production in Burgettstown, Pennsylvania, makes sustainably sourced metal powders for additive manufacturing — titanium Ti-6Al-4V, nickel superalloys Ni625 and Ni718, stainless SS316L, refractory tungsten, niobium C103, copper C18150 and the HEA1000 refractory alloy — reclaiming CNC scrap and revert metal into premium AM powder. 6K Energy produces domestically sourced lithium-ion battery cathode and solid-state materials including NMC, LFP, LLZO, LMO, LTO and LNMO. Additional applications span semiconductor CMP, specialty ceramics, advanced coatings, lighting and display materials, nano-engineered powders, and federal/defense programs; 6K has received US Department of Defense and Department of Energy awards for domestic critical-materials capacity. 6K is a privately held company whose shares trade on secondary markets. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-31 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, agent card, or event surface — 6K is a materials manufacturer, not an API provider.

providers.name: Airforestry
providers.description: AirForestry is a Swedish climate-technology company developing autonomous electric drones that perform forest thinning from the air. Its system pairs AI and computer vision for tree identification and selection with a lightweight aerial harvesting tool, letting a fleet of drones fell and extract trees without ground machinery. The result is forestry with zero soil compaction, no root damage and no machine tracks, higher operational efficiency, and lower emissions than conventional harvesters, while increasing forest growth and carbon sequestration. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It currently publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Claros
providers.description: Claros is a data center power delivery company reimagining how energy moves from chip to grid for AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. Based in Torrance, California with an office in McLean, Virginia, the company builds two hardware-and-software product lines: an Integrated Voltage Regulator (IVR) that targets the roughly 40 percent of chip power lost to heat at the point of delivery, and a Power Gateway that manages broader data center power distribution where 30 to 50 percent of power is lost to transmission, conversion, and cooling. Claros is an early-stage hardware company backed by General Catalyst and Red Cell Partners; its founding team collectively holds 286 patents and has brought more than 80 gigawatts of projects to market. As of 2026 it is pre-product (prototypes in development, engineering samples planned for 2026, low-volume production 2027, high-volume scale 2028) and publishes no developer API, SDK, or public documentation surface yet — this profile captures its public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: EverestLabs
providers.description: EverestLabs builds AI, computer vision, and robotics for the recycling industry. Its RecycleOS platform identifies, tracks, and sorts recoverable materials on the conveyor lines of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), giving recyclers, reclaimers, and packaging manufacturers analytics, bale tracing, plant optimization, and compliance reporting to increase recovery rates, cut labor costs, and verify recycled content. Headquartered in Fremont, California and backed by Sierra Ventures. EverestLabs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, GitHub, and discovery surface.

providers.name: Juna.ai
providers.description: Juna.ai is a Berlin-based industrial AI company building an Agentic Factory OS — a platform of autonomous AI agents that plan, steer, and continuously improve complex industrial production processes. Its agents ingest live plant data through integrations with existing IT/OT systems (SAP, Siemens, AVEVA, PI Server, Snowflake), model assets and processes into a Factory Graph and Knowledge Graph, detect anomalies, run root-cause analysis, generate reports, and recommend or execute control actions 24/7 with human-in-the-loop oversight and full traceability. Juna targets heavy and process industries including chemicals, cement, pulp & paper, glass, food & beverage, pharma, consumer goods, and industrial manufacturing, focused on maximizing output, quality, energy efficiency, and sustainability. The company is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Norrsken VC, and John Doerr. Juna delivers integration through enterprise engagements and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Normative
providers.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

providers.name: Project Canary
providers.description: Project Canary is a Denver-based climate technology company that helps oil and gas operators and natural gas utilities turn methane emissions data into operational intelligence. Founded in 2019, its Canary SENSE platform unifies measurement data from sensors, satellites, aircraft, SCADA, and field teams into a single view that drives decisions, reduces costs, and supports regulatory reporting (OGMP 2.0 and other frameworks). The company builds high-precision methane detection hardware (Canary RECON, Aeris PICO) and a proprietary predictive emissions model (methaneML) trained on a multi-year, high-fidelity methane dataset, serving upstream and midstream operators as well as gas distribution utilities across the United States. Project Canary has raised $121M (Series B) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Techstars. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI is published at this time; this profile captures identity, a verbatim llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Terrascope
providers.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

providers.name: Better Origin
providers.description: Better Origin is a UK-based agritech company decarbonizing the food chain by converting food waste into sustainable, locally produced animal feed. Its core technology is a fully automated, AI-controlled containerized insect farm that breeds black soldier fly larvae to consume food waste and produce nutrient-rich insect-based ingredients for pet food, poultry feed, and aquaculture. The systems are remotely monitored and controlled by software and require no specialist knowledge from operators. Better Origin is a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Beyond Meat
providers.description: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based producer of plant-based meat substitutes founded in 2009 and publicly traded on Nasdaq (BYND). The company makes plant-protein versions of beef, pork, and poultry products, including the Beyond Burger, Beyond Sausage, Beyond Beef, and Beyond Chicken, distributed across grocery retail and foodservice channels worldwide. Beyond Meat operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than a technology or developer-platform company; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce website, product and recipe catalogs, a newsroom, and an investor-relations presence, but does not offer a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins and Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Black Sheep Foods
providers.description: Black Sheep Foods is a San Francisco food-technology company making plant-based meat that targets the flavors and textures of premium and heritage animal proteins — starting with its signature meat-free lamb, plus steak bites, built on a proprietary pea-protein DualTexture blend. Originally launched as a restaurant and retail brand (served at Bay Area restaurants and sold as vegan ground lamb), the company has increasingly positioned itself as a B2B ingredient supplier, licensing its DualTexture protein platform for hybrid and fully plant-based meat products. It is venture-backed (investors include Bessemer Venture Partners and AgFunder) and pitches a sustainability story of far lower land, water, and greenhouse-gas footprint than conventionally raised lamb. This is a consumer/ ingredient food-tech business with no first-party public developer API; its web presence runs on Shopify.

providers.name: Chiquita Brands International
providers.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

providers.name: Ethic
providers.description: Ethic is an SEC-registered technology-driven asset manager that helps financial advisors and institutions build and manage highly customized, values-aligned, and tax-smart investment portfolios at scale. Its platform centralizes client portfolio management across direct indexing, model portfolios, and unified managed accounts (UMAs), letting advisors personalize holdings to individual values and tax situations. Ethic is a private, advisor- and institution-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks as of this profiling.

providers.name: Finres
providers.description: Finres (finres SAS) is a French climate-risk analytics company building a decision platform for agriculture. It translates climate hazards into economic consequences for farms, agricultural value chains and territories, combining agronomic, pedological, climate and market data with AI models that are peer-reviewed and validated against published research. Two productized offerings sit on top of the platform - a farm-level economic and climate viability diagnostic (DPEC, currently in beta, seeded from a grower's TelePAC parcel file and reference datasets such as Agreste, IPPAP and RICA) and bespoke territorial or sector studies. Finres was founded by Florent Baarsch, previously with the World Bank, the United Nations and climate research institutes, and its customers include the French government, the World Bank, the Green Climate Fund, IFAD and the FAO. The company markets high-resolution data delivery into customer decision systems, but as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or SDK - access is arranged through a sales demo.

providers.name: Glyph
providers.description: Glyph is a sustainable footwear brand that designs digitally knit, versatile everyday shoes engineered to be worn for every occasion. Backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through its Shopify storefront at glyph.earth, emphasizing low-waste digital knitting, single-shoe versatility, and eco-conscious materials. Glyph is a physical consumer-products (DTC e-commerce) company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web and policy surface for network completeness.

providers.name: Pelikan Mobility
providers.description: Pelikan Mobility is a Paris-based smart-leasing and fleet-management company for electric commercial vehicles, founded in late 2022 by David Salfati and Vincent Schachter. It operates two products: Pelikan Lease, a very-long-term leasing offer (up to 10 years / 300,000 km) for electric utility vans that targets a 20% lower total cost of ownership, and Pelikan FleetPilot, a SaaS platform using digital twins, optimization algorithms and generative AI to plan fleet renewal, electrification and vehicle redeployment across large B2B fleets in utilities, maintenance, construction and logistics. The company is backed by Seedcamp, Frst and PaleBlueDot Ventures. It publishes a marketing and resources website but exposes no public API or developer surface at this time; this profile records its identity and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Suplari
providers.description: Suplari is an enterprise procurement intelligence platform that goes beyond spend analytics, using AI to clean, classify, and unify fragmented spend data across ERP, P2P, and spreadsheet sources. It delivers spend analytics, value orchestration, savings tracking, contract intelligence, and ESG intelligence, alongside procurement-specific AI agents (Suplari Worker, Assistant, and AI Studio) that integrate with SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Databricks, Snowflake, and Microsoft. Suplari was acquired by Microsoft in 2021. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Vartega
providers.description: Vartega is a Denver, Colorado-based advanced materials company that produces recycled carbon fiber (rCF) from post-industrial scrap as a sustainable, lower-cost drop-in alternative to virgin carbon fiber. Its product line includes EasyFeed Bundles for thermoplastic compounding, chopped carbon fiber in multiple lengths and sizings, and carbon fiber reinforced polypropylene and nylon pellets. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Whisper Aero
providers.description: Whisper Aero is a Crossville, Tennessee based aerospace company developing ultra-quiet electric ducted-fan propulsion that converts electricity into thrust with roughly 20 percent more efficiency and 20 dB less noise than conventional systems, scaling from 5 to 500 pounds of thrust and 40 to 400 knots for aviation, defense, and commercial applications. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Lux Capital, and Menlo Ventures. The company is a hardware manufacturer and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Boston Metal
providers.description: Boston Metal is an industrial metals and materials company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, with a wholly owned subsidiary and commercial plant in Brazil. The company commercializes Molten Oxide Electrolysis (MOE), a one-step electrochemical process that uses clean electricity rather than fossil fuels to reduce iron ore into liquid metal, producing steel with no direct CO2 emissions, and to recover high-value critical metals such as niobium and tantalum from low-grade ore and mining waste. Boston Metal commissioned a multi-inert-anode industrial MOE cell at its Woburn facility and has raised over $500 million from investors including Tata Steel. Boston Metal is a physical process-technology and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind. This profile captures its public web, corporate, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: EnviCore
providers.description: EnviCore is a Calgary, Alberta based sustainability and materials-technology company, backed by Techstars, that produces low-carbon supplementary cementitious materials for the mining and construction industries. Its low-temperature process repurposes industrial waste, mine tailings, clays, and pozzolans into valuable cement replacements, reducing CO2 emissions and supporting a circular economy. EnviCore does not publish a developer API, but its public website exposes an agentic surface: a published llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI-agent access to public site content.

providers.name: National Invasive Species Information Center
providers.description: National Invasive Species Information Center (NISIC) is the gateway to invasive species information covering federal, state, local, and international sources. Invasive species are plants, animals, or pathogens that are non-native to the ecosystem under consideration, and whose introduction causes or is likely to cause harm.

providers.name: National Pesticide Information Center
providers.description: The National Pesticide Information Center (NPIC) provides objective, science-based information about pesticides and their potential health and environmental effects. NPIC is a cooperative agreement between Oregon State University and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, serving the general public, health professionals, and pesticide manufacturers.

providers.name: Schnitzer Steel Industries
providers.description: Schnitzer Steel Industries, now rebranded as Radius Recycling (acquired by Toyota Tsusho in 2025), is one of the largest manufacturers and exporters of recycled metal products in North America. The company processes scrap metal from automotive and industrial sources for use in steelmaking, operating 103 recycling facilities including the Pick-n-Pull auto parts chain and Cascade Steel Rolling Mills in McMinnville, Oregon. Schnitzer/Radius Recycling does not expose a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: 280 Earth
providers.description: 280 Earth is a direct air capture (DAC) company that permanently removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Originally launched in 2018 inside X, the Alphabet moonshot factory, and spun out as an independent company in 2022, it is backed by Sergey Brin, Builders VC and a $50M Series B. Its proprietary sorbent moves through a gravity-fed dual-chamber system that continuously cycles material between capturing and releasing CO2, running on low-grade industrial waste heat or clean electricity and producing fresh water as a byproduct. Its first pilot plant, in The Dalles, Oregon, captures 500 tons of CO2 per year on a site sized for more than 20,000 tons per year at full build-out, and underpins a $40M offtake agreement with the Frontier carbon removal buyer consortium (Google, Meta, Stripe, Shopify and others). 280 Earth is a hardware and carbon-removal operator; as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer surface, API, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Ameresco
providers.description: Ameresco is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ameresco API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Interface Inc
providers.description: Interface Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Interface Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Cubenergy
providers.description: Cubenergy (ShenZhen Cubenergy Co., Ltd. / 库博能源) is a BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale deployments. The company integrates self-developed Battery Systems, BMS, and EMS with grid, PV, wind, and diesel generation into standardized, all-in-one, transportable, EPC-free energy storage products (FlexCombo, PowerCombo E5, FlexCombo D2, FlexCube C1). Its products are certified to UL9540, UL9540A, and NFPA855, and it offers an O&M platform plus bankability (DNV certified, AIG insured) for funded and insured projects. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Cubenergy publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: De-Ice
providers.description: De-Ice Technologies is a Somerville, Massachusetts deep-tech aviation startup building a chemical-free aircraft de-icing system that replaces conventional glycol spray with electrically heated strips applied to aircraft surfaces, removing snow and ice prior to takeoff. The technology eliminates weather-related departure delays, cuts glycol spraying costs, and reduces CO₂ emissions from idling fuel burn and chemical production. Named to Time's Best Inventions of 2024, De-Ice counts Air Canada as its launch customer and is backed by Techstars. This is a physical-hardware aviation company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Earth AI
providers.description: Earth AI is a vertically integrated, AI-powered mineral exploration company that discovers, develops, and owns critical mineral mines for the emerging hardware economy — data centers, humanoid robots, eVTOL aircraft, fusion energy, space, and defense. Its proprietary predictive model, MTP, is trained on roughly 400 million geological sites to identify the source rocks of new mineral deposits and dramatically compress traditional exploration timelines. The company vertically integrates the search for critical minerals: it predicts targets with AI, acquires mineral rights, and drills to prove and own the resource. Earth AI is backed by DCVC and has been profiled by TechCrunch, Business Insider, and The Generalist's Future 50. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Earth AI does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Ecolectro
providers.description: Ecolectro is an Ithaca, New York materials-science company developing alkaline exchange membrane (AEM) technology for green hydrogen production. Its patented ionomers and membranes combine the low-cost, non-precious-metal chemistry of traditional alkaline electrolysis with the performance and efficiency of PEM electrolyzers, targeting roughly a 78% reduction in electrolyzer stack cost and a 33% reduction in the overall levelized cost of green hydrogen. A Cornell University spin-out backed by Techstars, Ecolectro partners with industrial gas and energy companies to manufacture and deploy its membrane materials at scale. Ecolectro publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Encentive
providers.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Energy Vault
providers.description: Energy Vault Holdings (NYSE: NRGV) is a Swiss-founded, US-headquartered energy storage company delivering grid-scale storage hardware, software, and services worldwide. Its portfolio spans battery energy storage (B-VAULT), gravity-based storage (G-VAULT / EVx), and green-hydrogen storage (H-VAULT), unified by VaultOS, an energy management software platform providing real-time monitoring, operational control, and optimized dispatch across storage and generation assets, alongside Vault Bidder and Vault Manager for market bidding and asset management. The company serves utilities, independent power producers, and large energy users, with more than 1.4 GWh deployed since 2023. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Energy Vault is a frontier-tech company in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; VaultOS is delivered as a proprietary, deployment-integrated platform rather than a public API product.

providers.name: feld.energy
providers.description: feld.energy (Feld.Energy GmbH) is a Freising, Germany based Agri-PV (agrivoltaics) project developer and investment company that helps farmers and landowners install turnkey agricultural photovoltaic systems on their fields. It combines expertise from agriculture, energy, and project development to co-locate crop or livestock production with solar generation, offering landowners lease income, revenue sharing, or full-ownership models with state-secured grid feed-in over roughly 20 years. The company handles every step from land assessment and permitting through construction and operation. It reports 800+ partner farmers, 900+ hectares of projects, and 320+ MW of secured grid capacity. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital and is in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy company profile; it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Lowercarbon Capital
providers.description: Lowercarbon Capital is a climate-focused venture capital firm that backs companies making real money by slashing CO2 emissions, removing carbon from the atmosphere, and buying the planet more time. The firm invests across energy, transportation, materials, agriculture, carbon removal, and planetary-cooling technologies, on the thesis that markets — not shame or guilt — will fix the climate. It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network. Lowercarbon Capital publishes no public API or developer program; this profile captures the firm's identity and web properties.

providers.name: ProLogium Technology
providers.description: ProLogium Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese energy-innovation company founded in 2006 that develops and manufactures next-generation solid-state lithium ceramic batteries built around a 100% ceramic separator. It commercialized its first solid-state cells in 2013, opened the world's first giga-level solid-state lithium ceramic battery plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan in 2024, and operates a European R&D center at Paris-Saclay with a planned gigafactory in Dunkirk, France. Its product lines span FLCB, PLCB and LLCB cells plus battery modules and packs, targeting electric vehicles, energy storage systems, robotics, and consumer and industrial applications. ProLogium is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Savion Aerospace
providers.description: Savion Aerospace (FlySavion) is an aerospace company developing sustainable, zero-emissions aviation technology. Its flagship SavionJet is an autonomous blended-wing-body (ABWB) aircraft with a standup cabin and satellite-based piloting via proprietary autonomous flight software, and the company offers Zero-Emissions Flight Credits (ZFCs) as a subscription for organizations seeking carbon-free air travel beyond offsetting. Savion demonstrated a cryogenic LNG-fueled flight in 2019 and is a 500 Global (500 Startups) and Alchemist Accelerator portfolio company. The company operates as an aviation hardware and services business and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Verkor
providers.description: Verkor is a French cleantech manufacturer founded in 2020 to fast-track low-carbon lithium-ion battery production in Europe. Operating a "digital by design" industrial model, Verkor produces high-performance battery cells and modules for electric mobility and stationary energy storage, scaling through its Dunkerque Gigafactory toward 16 GWh of annual cell capacity to serve the European market. Verkor is a physical-products/industrial company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: Visolis
providers.description: Visolis is a biomanufacturing company that combines synthetic biology with chemical catalysis to convert plant biomass into MEV (mevalonic acid), a proprietary platform molecule used to make sustainable, bio-based alternatives to petroleum-derived chemicals and fuels. Its products include bio-isoprene for synthetic rubber (a partnership with Zeon), AroSAF 100% bio-based sustainable aviation fuel, and non-toxic bio-based industrial solvents (piloted with the U.S. Department of Defense). Headquartered in San Leandro, California and led by CEO Deepak Dugar, Visolis is a climate-tech company surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Visolis publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Windward
providers.description: Windward is a Maritime AI company headquartered in London and Washington D.C. delivering mission-grade, multi-source maritime intelligence for defense agencies, law enforcement, customs, energy and commodity traders, marine insurers, shippers, and financial institutions. Founded by CEO Ami Daniel, Windward fuses AIS data, remote sensing (EO, SAR, RF GEOINT), proprietary behavioral analytics, and generative AI into a single Maritime AI platform covering vessel screening, ownership and entity resolution, sanctions exposure, deceptive shipping detection, ship-to-ship transfer analysis, IUU fishing detection, smuggling detection, container tracking, and maritime infrastructure protection. Windward exposes its intelligence through the API Insights Lab, a unified GraphQL API at developer.windward.ai providing programmatic access to vessel risk scores, Organization Defined Risk (ODR), ultimate beneficial ownership, early detection signals, tracked shipments, carriers, and detention & demurrage data, along with webhooks and workflow automation. The company has no public REST/OpenAPI surface, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub org — its API is GraphQL-only with managed onboarding and expert-led implementation support.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: CleanCapital
providers.description: CleanCapital is a New York based clean energy investment firm, founded in 2015, that develops, constructs, acquires, owns and operates distributed-generation solar and energy storage projects across the United States. It concentrates on the commercial and municipal middle market between residential rooftop and utility-scale generation, selling power to businesses, schools, nonprofits, municipalities and community solar subscribers, and it buys operating and late-stage development projects from developers through a dedicated project-acquisition practice. The firm reports more than $1.5 billion of capital deployed, 450+ MW under management, 235 MW developed and constructed, 200+ energy customers and over 1,000 GWh of emissions-free generation, backed by institutional partners including Manulife Investment Management / John Hancock, BlackRock and CarVal Investors. CleanCapital is an asset owner and investment manager rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its customer portal at app.cleancapital.com now redirects to the third-party Dock Energy platform.

providers.name: CONSOL Energy
providers.description: CONSOL Energy was a Pittsburgh-based coal mining company that produced high-quality bituminous coal from underground mines for sale to electric utilities, steelmakers, and industrial customers. In 2025 CONSOL Energy merged with Arch Resources to form Core Natural Resources, and the consolenergy.com domain now redirects to corenaturalresources.com.
