The combined company does not publish public developer APIs; its external digital surface is organized around an investor relations site, a suppliers page (with downloadable terms, conditions, and a Supplier Code of Conduct), and corporate sustainability/safety disclosures — all HTML and PDF, with no documented endpoints and no XML feeds (probed 2026-07-25). Those pages are listed below as website surfaces, not as APIs. The only verified programmatic access to this company's data is the SEC's own EDGAR APIs. See the sibling profile arch-coal for the other half of the merger.

providers.name: Esper Satellite Imagery
providers.description: Esper Satellite Imagery is an Australian space-technology company building an 18-satellite hyperspectral Earth-observation constellation (the Over The Rainbow / OTR program) to deliver global chemical-composition data of the planet's surface from orbit. Its Esperesso hyperspectral imagers capture more than 100 contiguous spectral bands spanning roughly 400 to 1000 nm, which Esper turns into mineralisation maps that identify lithium, rare earths, gold, nickel, cobalt and alteration zones for critical-mineral exploration — faster, cheaper and greener than traditional ground surveys. Founded in 2021 in Melbourne, Victoria by Iqbal and Joey Lorenczak, Esper sells custom area-of-interest mineral maps and a pre-built Northern Territory mineral map. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, security and code-repository surface.

providers.name: Flowcarbon
providers.description: Flowcarbon is a climate-finance company that provides project finance and bespoke capital solutions for companies working in infrastructure, decarbonization, and frontier climate industries. Its end-to-end services span project origination, screening and due diligence, deal structuring, and tax-credit solutions, with a focus on engineered carbon-removal technologies such as biochar and enhanced rock weathering. Founded with a web3 heritage in tokenized voluntary carbon credits and backed by a16z and General Catalyst, Flowcarbon today operates primarily as a climate project-finance firm rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: JetZero
providers.description: JetZero is a Long Beach, California aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom O'Leary and Mark Page to bring the blended wing body (all-wing) airframe to commercial aviation. Its flagship program is the Z4, a 250-seat, international-range jetliner the company says will burn up to 50% less fuel than comparable tube-and-wing airliners, and the Jet1 full-scale demonstrator being built with Scaled Composites in Mojave, California ahead of a first flight targeted for 2027. JetZero broke ground in 2026 on a manufacturing and final-assembly campus in Greensboro, North Carolina and is opening an engineering office in Wichita, Kansas at NIAR. It is backed by the U.S. Air Force, NASA, United Airlines, Alaska Star Ventures and a $175M Series B led by B Capital, with letters of intent from Gulf Air and Japan Airlines. JetZero is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software or data provider: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public technical surface is a supplier registration and supplier standards program.

providers.name: Lilac Solutions
providers.description: Lilac Solutions is an Oakland, California climate-technology company founded in 2016 that develops direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology built on proprietary ion exchange media. Its ion exchange beads and modular brine processing systems pull battery-grade lithium from high-grade, low-grade and complex brines without evaporation ponds, cutting water use and shrinking the land footprint and time-to-production of conventional lithium operations. Lilac operates mini-pilot, field-pilot and commercial deployments across the Great Salt Lake in Utah, Nevada, Argentina, Chile, Germany and Indonesia, and manufactures its ion exchange media on a dedicated production line in Nevada. The company is venture-backed with roughly $350M raised, employs about 200 people, and sells industrial hardware and process technology to lithium producers — it publishes no public developer platform, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Lyten
providers.description: Lyten is a San Jose, California advanced-materials company founded in 2015 that invented and commercializes Lyten 3D Graphene, a tunable three-dimensional carbon supermaterial produced by converting methane into nanostructured carbon while co-producing hydrogen. Lyten applies that materials platform across four product lines: lithium-sulfur battery cells and battery systems that contain no cobalt, nickel or manganese and target roughly 40% weight savings versus lithium-ion; 3D graphene reinforced 3D printer filament; concrete admixture and structural adhesives; and chemical/environmental sensors, including the Lyten Atmos continuous methane-intelligence platform that pairs solar-powered LTE field sensors with cloud analytics and dashboards for landfill and oil-and-gas emissions monitoring. The company has raised over $600 million from investors including Stellantis, FedEx and Honeywell, operates a 145,000 sq ft pilot manufacturing facility in the Alviso district of North San Jose, acquired Cuberg's San Leandro battery assets in 2024, and in 2025 acquired Northvolt battery manufacturing assets in Poland and Sweden, establishing a European headquarters in Gdansk, Poland. Lyten is a private company; its shares trade on secondary markets such as Forge Global. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: Sleek EV
providers.description: Sleek EV (SLEEK EV) is a Thai-Singaporean electric motorcycle company founded in 2022, headquartered in Singapore with primary operations in Thailand. Under the mission "Sustainability must be affordable," it builds accessible electric two-wheelers — the TYPE-S, TYPE-E and TYPE-X motorcycles and the SLEEK Play 1.0 urban scooter — powered by its S-DRIVE powertrain and IP67-rated lithium-ion batteries (via Ampace/CATL). It runs the S-Charge fast-charging network (100+ stations across Bangkok) and a SLEEK App for vehicle monitoring, route planning and station finding, sold through a nationwide dealer network. BOI-certified and backed by ORZON Ventures (OR + 500 TukTuks), January Capital, A2D Ventures and Krungsri Finnovate. This is a consumer product company with no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Sourceful
providers.description: Sourceful is a Manchester, United Kingdom packaging technology company that began as a sustainable packaging marketplace connecting brands with vetted manufacturers and offering data-driven carbon footprint, life-cycle, and recyclability metrics for every packaging design. Founded in 2020 by Wing Chan and Charlie Bradshaw, the company raised roughly $32M from investors including Index Ventures, Coatue, and Eka Ventures, and grew to over 100 employees serving climate-conscious consumer brands. Since 2024–2025 Sourceful has pivoted toward AI-powered visual design for packaging, releasing Sourceful 3.0 and Riverflow 1, a proprietary image-editing foundation model marketed as state-of-the-art for design-grade, print-ready packaging artwork. The current product line covers AI logo design, packaging design, AI product photography, image editing, packaging ranges, flavor/variant ranges, brand moodboards, and (announced) product mockups and social ads. Sourceful is ISO 42001 certified for AI management. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub organization for the packaging/design platform, and the original sustainable-packaging marketplace surface and supplier-facing carbon footprint API have been superseded by the AI design product; there is no Sourceful developer portal at this time. The unrelated github.com/sourceful organization belongs to Pony Foo, not this company, and sourceful.energy is a separate distributed-energy-resource platform unrelated to Sourceful Ltd.

providers.name: United Solar
providers.description: United Solar (United Solar Polysilicon FZC SPC) is a clean-technology company producing ultra-high-purity polysilicon for the photovoltaic industry from one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities in Oman's Sohar Free Zone, with an annual capacity of 100,000 metric tons supporting roughly 40 GW of solar module production. Backed by IDG Capital and the IFC, the company completed a $1.6 billion capital raise in 2026 and is the largest polysilicon producer of its kind outside China. United Solar is an industrial manufacturer and does not publish a developer portal or public APIs.

providers.name: XFuel
providers.description: XFuel develops, patents, and deploys technologies that transform diverse waste into low-carbon drop-in transport fuels, using its Chemical Liquid Refining (CLR) and Mechanical Carbon Conversion (MECC) processes to produce marine (ISO 8217 DMA), road (EN590), and in-development sustainable aviation fuels. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with operations in Bunyola, Spain, and backed by Union Square Ventures. XFuel publishes no public API or developer program as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Diamond Foundry
providers.description: Diamond Foundry is a deep-tech materials company that manufactures semiconductor-grade single-crystal diamond wafers and diamond transistors to overcome the thermal limits of silicon in AI chips, datacenters, and electric vehicles. The company operates its own foundries and has built a full technology stack for producing diamond at scale as a sustainable substrate for high-performance and power electronics. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a planetary-health portfolio company of Obvious Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: INURU
providers.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Lithos
providers.description: Lithos Carbon is a deep-tech carbon-removal company that spreads crushed basalt on croplands to accelerate enhanced rock weathering, converting atmospheric CO2 into dissolved bicarbonate that is permanently stored as ocean carbonates. The company pairs soil models and machine learning with agronomic partnerships to maximize durable carbon dioxide removal while improving soil health and crop productivity for farmers, and sells the resulting high-permanence carbon credits to corporate buyers. Surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Lizee
providers.description: Lizee is a Paris-based Retail-as-a-Service platform that helps brands and retailers launch and operate circular commerce programs — rental, resale, and second-hand — end to end. Its stack pairs a rental platform, a resale/e-commerce platform, and a logistics platform (returns, refurbishment, reverse logistics) behind an operations API so a brand can offer rent or buy-back experiences on top of its existing catalog. Lizee runs a production API (api.lizee.io) and publishes a public Atlassian Statuspage, though it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs — the API surface is partner and integration facing. Lizee was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Speedinvest.

providers.name: Propagate Ventures
providers.description: Propagate (formerly Propagate Ventures) is a regenerative-agriculture company founded in 2017 that helps farmland owners, farmers, and investors design, plant, finance, and manage agroforestry and tree-crop systems. Its flagship SaaS product, Overyield, lets farmers, developers, and investors model tree-crop economics, choose crops, and design tree-crop systems that work alongside existing farm operations. Propagate pairs the software with technical assessments, site prep and planting services, improved tree genetics, and ongoing project monitoring, and is a partner in the USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities. The company advises 30,000+ acres of agroforestry supporting over 760,000 trees and shrubs. Propagate publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Whole Surplus
providers.description: Whole Surplus (now operating as Fazla) is a Turkish technology-based waste management and circular-economy company backed by Techstars. It prevents waste at its source and recovers surplus products back into the circular economy with maximum environmental, social, and economic benefit across the entire supply chain from producers to consumers. Its platform combines an AI-powered analysis tool that identifies the optimal recovery path for each product with services including Fazla Market (discounted resale), donations to food banks, animal-feed conversion, recycling, a smart-scale detection system, and sustainability consultancy. Fazla is the first B Corp certified waste-management company in Turkey and is supported by the UN Development Programme (UNDP). The company operates a customer web application (app.fazla.com) but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: Amyris
providers.description: Amyris, Inc. is a synthetic-biology and precision-fermentation company that engineers microbes to convert plant-derived sugars into high-performance renewable molecules — including farnesene, squalene, squalane, and bisabolol — at industrial scale. The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: BlocPower
providers.description: BlocPower is a Brooklyn-based climate technology and building decarbonization company, founded in 2014 as a Public Benefit Corporation, that makes urban buildings smarter, greener, and healthier with a focus on historically underserved communities. It combines deep building-science expertise with accessible financing to deliver energy-efficiency retrofits and electrification measures such as heat pumps, pairing construction management with clean-energy upgrades. As of late 2023 BlocPower reported more than 1,200 completed measures across 1,100+ buildings nationwide, thousands of metric tons of CO2e reduced, and hundreds of local job placements, earning recognition from the White House, EPA, and TIME. BlocPower is a portfolio company of a16z and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Council on Environmental Quality
providers.description: The Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) is an office within the Executive Office of the President of the United States that coordinates federal environmental policy, advises the President on environmental and natural resource policies, and oversees the implementation of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). CEQ does not publish a public developer API. Federal NEPA documents and related environmental data are surfaced through partner federal agencies and platforms (NEPAtool, the Federal Permitting Dashboard, regulations.gov, EPA EJScreen, and the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool).

providers.name: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED
providers.description: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED (Neo Mobility) is a UAE-based B2B electric-mobility startup driving sustainable transportation across the MENA region. Neo bundles electric-vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, an integrated fleet/driver/operations/energy management platform, driver-safety programs, and human-capital support into a single subscription-based ecosystem — delivering EV Delivery-as-a-Service for e-commerce, food delivery, and last-mile logistics, alongside e-taxi mobility. The company publishes no public developer or API program; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: ConocoPhillips
providers.description: ConocoPhillips is a leading global exploration and production company, headquartered in Houston, Texas, that is uniquely equipped to deliver reliable, responsibly produced oil and natural gas. The company operates in more than a dozen countries with conventional and unconventional crude oil, natural gas, LNG, and natural gas liquids assets. ConocoPhillips does not publish public developer APIs; its external digital surface is organized around an investor relations portal, a vendor relations portal (powered by third-party platforms such as GEP and Taulia), an LNG technology and licensing program, and a custom sustainability report builder.

providers.name: Fortera
providers.description: Fortera is a Silicon Valley materials-technology company advancing zero-CO2 cement. Its ReCarb process economically converts captured CO2 into ReAct green cement that meets regulatory standards and can be blended with or used in place of Ordinary Portland Cement inside existing production infrastructure. Fortera operates its first commercial ReCarb plant in Redding, California, holds 100+ patents, and is backed by Khosla Ventures and Temasek. The company is a climate-tech materials producer rather than a software/API provider; it publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt but no developer API surface.

providers.name: PolyXLabs
providers.description: PolyXLabs is a Techstars-backed biotechnology and sustainable-materials company developing biodegradable plastic alternatives from lignocellulose-based biomass, including food waste such as spent coffee grounds. The company produces customized, toxin-free, microplastic-free polymers designed to be lightweight and durable as drop-in replacements for conventional plastics in consumer goods and packaging, with operations across the United States and Europe and headquarters in Martonvasar, Hungary. PolyXLabs currently publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aclarity Water
providers.description: Aclarity, Inc. (Aclarity Water) is a Medway, Massachusetts cleantech company that designs and manufactures on-site PFAS destruction technology. Its flagship Aclarity Octa system uses electrochemical oxidation to break the carbon-fluorine bond in per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), destroying these "forever chemicals" at landfills, centralized waste-treatment facilities, industrial sites (laundry, pulp and paper, automotive), municipal and industrial wastewater, drinking-water treatment, and AFFF-contaminated aviation sites. Aclarity is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a physical water-treatment hardware and services business with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: Andes
providers.description: Andes (Andes Ag, Inc.) is a climate-technology and agricultural-biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Alameda, California. Andes engineers and selects beneficial soil microorganisms that are applied alongside seed in commodity row-crop production — corn, soybean, wheat and canola — where they accelerate the natural conversion of atmospheric carbon dioxide into stable soil inorganic carbon (carbonate minerals), a process the company calls Microbial Carbon Mineralization. Andes sells the resulting durable carbon dioxide removal as verified credits to corporate buyers and Scope 3 programs, and pays participating growers through the Andes Carbon Program. The company published the first Microbial Carbon Mineralization methodology, developed with EcoEngineers under ISO 14064, and has run field trials with Bayer, Cargill, Corteva, Nutrien and Wilbur-Ellis. Andes has raised roughly $38M, including a Series A co-led by Leaps by Bayer and Cavallo Ventures, and its shares trade on private secondary venues including EquityZen and Nasdaq Private Market. Andes publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Brumby
providers.description: Brumby (formerly GrazeMate) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2026) precision-grazing company based in Sydney, Australia, building an autonomous drone toolkit for cattle ranchers. Brumby drones plan routes and move herds with gentle, AI-guided pressure, fly scheduled monitoring missions that locate and count every animal, measure standing dry-matter pasture biomass from the air, and inspect water troughs, tanks and fences on every flight — all managed from a single phone app that works online or in a local base-station mode without connectivity. The company is running pilot programs and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is a company lead maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
providers.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) is a commercial fusion energy company headquartered in Devens, Massachusetts and spun out of the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center in 2018. CFS is developing tokamak-based fusion systems built around high-temperature superconducting (HTS) REBCO magnet technology that enables substantially smaller, faster, and lower-cost fusion machines than prior generations. The company's technology pipeline starts with SPARC, a net-energy demonstration tokamak under construction at the Devens campus, and continues with ARC, the planned first commercial fusion power plant, sited in Chesterfield County, Virginia in partnership with Dominion Energy and targeted to deliver approximately 400 MW of electricity to the grid in the early 2030s. CFS is backed by a deep investor base including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Eni, Equinor, Google, Temasek, Tiger Global, Khosla Ventures, Bill Gates, Soros Fund Management, Lowercase Capital, John Doerr, and TIME Ventures. CFS does not publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is via partnerships, careers, and investor channels.

providers.name: DayOne
providers.description: DayOne is a hyperscale data center company delivering next-generation digital infrastructure for cloud, AI, and edge computing workloads. Spun out of the GDS International business and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, DayOne develops and operates strategically located, interconnected data center campuses across Asia-Pacific — Singapore, Johor (Malaysia), Batam (Indonesia), Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Bangkok — and is expanding into Europe with a launch market in Finland. The company positions itself as a build-to-suit and hyperscale partner focused on power availability, connectivity, and sustainable operations rather than as a public API or developer-platform provider; there is no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: ECO2GROW
providers.description: ECO2GROW is a German renewable-energy procurement company serving mid-sized businesses. It builds an individually optimized electricity procurement mix that combines Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) sourced directly from German solar and wind farms with spot-market and forward contracts, giving companies enterprise-level pricing, long-term fixed rates, and traceable green power. The service automates the optimization of a company's procurement strategy and reduces the complexity and transaction costs of closing a PPA, helping industrial and mid-market buyers lower CO2 emissions through verifiable renewable sourcing. ECO2GROW is a Techstars portfolio company. As a B2B energy procurement and advisory business it operates a marketing/consulting web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Graphite Innovation and Technologies
providers.description: Graphite Innovation and Technologies Inc, operating as GIT Coatings, is a Canadian materials-science company that develops sustainable, graphene-based marine coatings for commercial ships. Its biocide-free hard foul-release hull and propeller coatings, including XGIT-FORCE, XGIT-VORTEX, and XGIT-PROP, cut fuel consumption, reduce drag, and eliminate leaching to protect the marine environment. The company is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. It is a physical-products manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and coverage.

providers.name: Greenlyte
providers.description: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies is an Essen, Germany based climate-tech company building its LiquidSolar platform, which liquefies air, sun, and water into 99% pure carbon and hydrogen feedstocks to produce synthetic e-fuels (sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic methanol, and synthetic natural gas) for hard-to-decarbonize industries. Founded as a direct air capture and power-to-liquid venture, Greenlyte has raised more than 55M EUR from Carbon Removal Partners, Earlybird, Partech, AENU, and Green Generation Fund. It was surfaced through VC portfolio mining and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Greenlyte publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: HelioRec
providers.description: HelioRec is a floating photovoltaic (FPV) engineering and manufacturing company that designs and builds floating solar power plants for lakes, reservoirs, and nearshore waters. It uses an engineering-led, load-based methodology focused on structural behavior, mooring integrity, installation practicality, and long-term operability on water, delivering grid-connected, utility-scale systems engineered for real water conditions. HelioRec serves independent power producers and utilities, hydropower and reservoir owners, industrial and infrastructure operators, and water and agriculture stakeholders, supporting projects from site-specific concept through execution. The company is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: HONESS (Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection)
providers.description: HONESS (泓济环保 / Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection, honess.cn) is a Chinese environmental services provider founded in 2006, specializing in industrial wastewater treatment and the broader treatment of the "three wastes" (wastewater, waste gas, and hazardous waste). It offers customized environmental solutions, environmental equipment manufacturing and integration, EPC delivery for energy and chemical full-water systems, fine-chemical waste treatment, process packages for new and upgraded wastewater plants, and technology-enabled ("smart") digital operations and maintenance. The company holds top-grade design and contracting qualifications, has delivered 500+ design/build/operation projects for 300+ clients across China and abroad, and operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Shanghai and Anhui. It is not a developer/API company; the public surface is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OAuth. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ideon Technologies
providers.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: Insempra
providers.description: Insempra is a biotechnology company that produces sustainable, bio-based ingredients using precision fermentation. It develops alternatives to petrochemical and naturally-extracted ingredients for the beauty and personal care, food and nutrition, and fibers and performance materials industries. Products include a bio-based Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol fragrance ingredient, an Omega-7 biolipid, and Biomelanin (in development), produced from agricultural and forestry waste streams through circular manufacturing. Insempra is a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Involve Space
providers.description: Involve Space is an Italian stratospheric aerospace company building real-time Earth intelligence. It operates autonomous high-altitude balloon platforms (Stratostats) that loiter around 20 kilometers for hours, days, or weeks to deliver continuous, high-resolution Earth observation, bridging the gap between satellites, drones, and ground sensors. Its Neurostar AI flight software autonomously controls individual balloons and networks of them (LoonHive), while the CLEAR GeoAI platform turns captured imagery into geospatial insights for disaster response, infrastructure and environmental monitoring, security, and in-orbit-demonstration / payload validation. A certified B Corporation headquartered in Italy with U.S. operations at the Houston Spaceport, Involve Space is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital, CDP Venture Capital, and an EIC Accelerator grant.

providers.name: Iwarranty
providers.description: iWarranty is a London-based, AI and machine-learning powered warranty management software platform that digitizes the entire warranty lifecycle for manufacturers, retailers, warrantors, and consumers. The platform covers QR-code product registration, automated claims processing and verification, repair and replacement coordination, fraud detection, and real-time product performance analytics, and integrates with existing ERP and CRM systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, and NetSuite. iWarranty emphasizes sustainability by reducing paper waste and e-waste through digitized processes. The company is backed by Anthemis and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network enrichment lead.

providers.name: Material Evolution
providers.description: Material Evolution is a UK-based cleantech manufacturer of ultra-low carbon cement for the construction industry. Its MevoCem and MevoXL products use a proprietary "Alkali Fusion" process to transform industrial byproducts into cement feedstocks, achieving a 52.5N strength rating at roughly 144-196 kg CO2e per tonne versus ordinary Portland cement. The company operates compact, automated factories (including its Wrexham facility) and applies AI to material development and feedstock optimization. It is a B2B cement supplier and does not currently publish any public developer-facing API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Mombak
providers.description: Mombak is a Brazilian nature-based carbon removal company that acquires degraded and deforested land in the Amazon and restores it through large-scale, biodiverse reforestation with native species, generating high-integrity, high-quality carbon removal credits for corporate buyers. Founded by former Nubank executives and backed by investors including Union Square Ventures, the company combines science, technology, forestry, and carbon-market expertise to remove carbon at scale while restoring native ecosystems. Mombak operates as a corporate and carbon-markets business and publishes a public marketing and news presence; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Plant Prefab
providers.description: Plant Prefab is a Southern California offsite construction technology company that custom-fabricates panelized and modular building components to deliver housing and hospitality projects in roughly half the time of traditional site-built construction. Its panel-based building system spans open-cavity panels to fully finished modules, and its LivingHomes product line and in-house Plant Design Studio offer customized, sustainable designs recognized with LEED Platinum, NAHB Energy Value Housing, and AIA Top Ten Green Projects awards. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Realta Fusion
providers.description: Realta Fusion is a fusion-energy company developing compact, scalable, modular magnetic-mirror fusion systems branded CoSMo fusion to deliver zero-carbon heat and electricity for industrial energy needs. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company designs prefabricated fusion modules that can be assembled to meet a variety of industrial power and process-heat requirements, targeting decarbonization of the roughly 37 billion metric tons of annual CO2 emissions from energy production. Realta Fusion is a hardware and energy-systems company and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Shift EV
providers.description: Shift EV is an electric-mobility company that retrofits existing commercial vehicles to electric power through an "electrofitting" service, converting fleet vehicles to EV drivetrains in under an hour with zero upfront cost. The company designs and installs plug-and-play EV drivetrains, lithium-ion battery packs, on-site charging infrastructure, and fleet-management software for FMCG, e-commerce, service, and OEM fleets. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Shift EV was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sizable Energy
providers.description: Sizable Energy is a Milan, Italy based clean-energy company developing offshore pumped hydro energy storage. Its patented system pairs subsea and floating reservoirs connected by pipes with reversible pump-turbines that move saturated sea-salt brine between them to deliver long-duration, grid-scale energy storage. The modular, scalable design leverages proven pumped-hydro technology with zero land use and integrates with floating wind and solar installations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Syntetica
providers.description: Syntetica is a French cleantech company using green chemistry to close the loop on synthetic textiles, starting with nylon. Its proprietary chemical process depolymerises nylon-blend fabrics, separating and purifying Nylon 6 and Nylon 6,6 from elastane, cotton, and other fibres in a single process to produce virgin-quality, low-carbon recycled polymers that drop in as replacements for fossil-derived nylon across textile, automotive, and high-performance applications. Backed by EQT Ventures, Bpifrance, SWEN Capital Partners, lululemon, and MAS Holdings, the company raised a $30M Series A in July 2026 to build its first commercial demonstration facility in France. Syntetica is a materials-science and manufacturing company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Thermondo
providers.description: Thermondo is Germany's largest residential heating installer, focused on heat pumps, photovoltaic (solar) systems, home energy management (thermondo smart), dynamic electricity tariffs, financing and subsidy assistance, and maintenance and repair services for homeowners. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Berlin, the company employs over 1,200 staff and has completed installations for more than 55,000 customers. Thermondo is a consumer-facing climate-energy provider and a portfolio company of HV Capital. It publishes no public developer API or documentation surface; it does operate a security.txt vulnerability-disclosure program and a GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from HV Capital's portfolio and enriched with the public security surface that could be verified.

providers.name: Treet
providers.description: Treet is a branded recommerce (resale) platform that lets e-commerce brands run their own secondhand marketplaces. Founded in 2021 by marketplace veterans Jake Disraeli and Sonia Yang (formerly of Indiegogo and Airbnb), Treet powers resale for 250+ global brands through four stackable programs: Peer-to-Peer (customers buy and sell from each other for cash or brand credit), Trade-In, Off-Price liquidation of excess inventory, and Returns rerouting. Treet integrates into a brand's existing commerce stack — Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and Salesforce Commerce, plus logistics (ShipHero, ShipBob), marketing/loyalty (Klaviyo, Yotpo, LoyaltyLion) and returns (Loop, Happy Returns) partners via its "Infinite Integrations" platform. Treet is an API consumer rather than an API producer: it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks of its own, and delivers to brands as a managed SaaS and Shopify app. Backed by Two Sigma Ventures and Techstars.

providers.name: TruckLabs
providers.description: TruckLabs built TruckWings, an automated tractor-mounted aerodynamic device that closes the gap between the tractor and trailer to reduce aerodynamic drag, cutting fuel consumption by a proven 3-6% and eliminating roughly 7-10 metric tons of CO2 per truck each year with an 18-24 month payback. The device deploys automatically at highway speed and retracts below it, reduces buffeting and trailer sway in crosswinds, and installs on both new builds and retrofits in about two hours. TruckLabs was acquired by ConMet, and trucklabs.com now redirects to the ConMet TruckWings product line. As a hardware fuel-efficiency company, TruckLabs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Entocycle
providers.description: Entocycle is a London-based insect farming technology company building industrial-scale, controlled-environment facilities that use black soldier fly bioconversion to turn organic waste streams into insect protein for animal feed and organic fertilizer (frass). Its platform combines modular climate-controlled farm infrastructure, real-time AI-driven insect monitoring that counts and tracks insects across their lifecycle, and fully automated production systems to standardize output across deployments worldwide. Entocycle partners with waste management companies, agricultural producers, insect companies, and offtake buyers to develop and operate circular-economy insect farms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Muon Space
providers.description: Muon Space is a Mountain View, California-based end-to-end space systems company that designs, builds, and operates mission-optimized satellite constellations to deliver Earth Intelligence and enable real-time compute and decision-making in space. Founded in 2021 by veterans of Skybox, NASA, and SpaceX, the company's core product is Muon Halo, an integrated technology stack composed of MuSim (constellation simulation and digital twin), MuOS (IP-based software-defined network middleware connecting space, ground, and cloud), MuCore (software-configurable instrument core), Condor (modular Condor-M and Condor-XL spacecraft platforms), and MuDash (cloud-based tasking, scheduling, and operations dashboard). Muon Space's flagship public mission is FireSat, a purpose-built wildfire detection and monitoring constellation developed with the Earth Fire Alliance, Google Research, and the Gordon & Betty Moore Foundation; FireSat carries a high-dynamic-range multispectral IR instrument capable of detecting 5x5 meter fires across a 1,500 km swath with a 50 m nadir ground sample distance, with revisit times targeted to twenty minutes once the full constellation is operational. The Protoflight satellite produced its first-light imagery in June 2025, with the first block of three additional satellites launching in 2026 and full operational capacity targeted for 2030. Other Muon Space missions support the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Space Force for next-generation weather monitoring, Hydrosat for thermal geospatial intelligence in climate and agriculture, and global security applications including missile-defense architecture. Muon Space's revenue model is mission contracting, spacecraft and constellation delivery, and hosted data services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release of the Halo platform or FireSat data feed.

providers.name: Schuettflix
providers.description: Schuettflix is a German digital logistics platform for the construction industry, founded in 2018 in Guetersloh. It operates a neutral B2B marketplace that connects construction companies, bulk-material suppliers, freight forwarders and waste-disposal firms in a single fully digital workflow. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers order sand, gravel and crushed stone with transparent real-time pricing, coordinate dispatch and transport, capture delivery documentation, manage routes, and handle mineral-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling of construction materials. The company digitizes the traditionally analog and fragmented process of procuring and delivering bulk goods, earning a commission on the transactions facilitated through its platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: Verse Enterprises
providers.description: Verse, Inc. is a San Francisco-based clean energy software company, founded in 2022 and backed by GV (Google Ventures), that helps organizations understand, plan, procure, and operate clean energy portfolios. Its AI-powered platform, Aria, is modular and app-based, turning complex energy, market, and financial data into finance-ready energy intelligence so enterprises can connect to the grid faster, contain electricity costs and risk, and control assets across every market and hour. Verse raised a $20.5M Series A led by GV, with participation from Coatue, CIV, and MCJ Collective, to help organizations reduce electricity costs and emissions.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Gbatteries
providers.description: GBatteries (GBatteries Energy Canada Inc.) is an Ottawa, Ontario battery technology company developing lithium-metal battery cells and an intelligent, adaptive battery management system for the next generation of electric mobility, from land to air. Its technology targets fast charging (sub-15-minute charge), high energy density (450+ Wh/kg), extended cycle life, and enhanced safety by actively reducing irreversible internal cell damage. The company reports 60+ granted or pending patents and 9+ years of R&D, and was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. GBatteries is a hardware and battery-management deeptech firm; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Aday
providers.description: Aday is a direct-to-consumer sustainable fashion brand founded in 2015 in New York City by Nina Faulhaber and Meg He. It designs technical, long-lasting capsule wardrobes built for outfit repetition, using custom recycled fabrics (including post-consumer recycled plastic) and plant-based, beechwood-derived materials produced in closed-loop processes. Aday has raised more than $10 million in venture capital, is backed by Cowboy Ventures, and has been named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, with coverage in Vogue, Refinery29, and Conde Nast Traveler. The company sells globally through its Shopify-powered storefront at thisisaday.com and does not publish a public developer API. This profile was created as an API Evangelist network stub from Cowboy Ventures' portfolio and enriched with company identity and domain-security signals; the storefront returned a Shopify "store is unavailable" lock at the time of the enrichment probe.

providers.name: Atomo Coffee
providers.description: Atomo Coffee is a Seattle-based food-tech company that makes beanless "molecular" coffee: it reverse-engineers the coffee bean and reconstructs the taste, aroma, and caffeine of coffee from upcycled, naturally derived plant ingredients, producing cold brew, ground, and canned products with a lower carbon and water footprint than conventional bean-grown coffee. Backed by bessemer-venture-partners and other investors, it sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at atomocoffee.com. Atomo is a consumer packaged-goods brand and publishes no first-party developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. Sector: deep-tech / food-tech.

providers.name: Ayr Energy
providers.description: Ayr Energy is a power grid equipment manufacturer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, backed by General Catalyst. The company designs and builds custom-engineered electrical infrastructure - power, distribution, and special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear - for renewable energy, data center, utility, industrial, and oil & gas customers. Ayr operates six manufacturing facilities across India (Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu) and emphasizes accelerated delivery of grid hardware in months rather than years. Ayr Energy does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bland Company
providers.description: The Bland Company is a London-based food-technology and biotechnology startup building functional plant proteins that replace eggs in food manufacturing. Its feedstock-agnostic process upcycles underused agricultural side streams into flavor-neutral, cost-stable proteins engineered to match animal-protein functionality — solubility, foaming, gelling, and emulsifying — for bakery, sauces, beverages, and snacks. The company raised a ~$2.7M pre-seed round led by Initialized Capital. It publishes no public developer API surface (no docs, SDKs, or GitHub); this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead.

providers.name: Impossible Foods
providers.description: Impossible Foods is a Redwood City, California food-technology company that develops plant-based substitutes for meat, including Impossible Beef, Sausage, Chicken, Meatballs, and Pork. Founded in 2011 by Patrick O. Brown, the company engineers its products around heme (soy leghemoglobin) to replicate the taste and texture of animal meat while reducing the environmental footprint of food production. Its products are distributed through grocery retail and tens of thousands of restaurants across the United States and international markets including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Impossible Foods is a private, venture-backed company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Remora
providers.description: Remora is a carbon-capture startup (legally Echeneidae Inc.) founded in 2020 and based in Wixom, Michigan, that retrofits semi-trucks and locomotives with zero-backpressure devices which extract and purify up to 90 percent of the CO2 from vehicle exhaust while cutting other pollutants. The company then sells the captured, purified carbon dioxide and shares the resulting revenue with the transportation operators it partners with. Remora is a hardware and climate-technology business with no public API or developer platform; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network company for portfolio and discovery purposes.

providers.name: TRIC Robotics
providers.description: TRIC Robotics builds autonomous agricultural robots that replace chemical pesticides with ultraviolet light. Its flagship platform, Luna, is a tractor-scale robot that roams California strawberry fields after dark, using UV-C light to kill fungal pathogens such as powdery mildew and botrytis while a mechanical "Bug Vac" removes pests like Lygus bugs, spotted wing drosophila, and spider mites — without a single drop of pesticide. Founded in 2017 by Dr. Adam Stager and Vishnu Somasundaram out of the University of Delaware and now based in California, TRIC operates a robotics-as-a-service model that requires no upfront investment from growers, and reports pesticide reductions of up to 70% across the farms it serves. The company raised a $5.5M seed round led by Version One Ventures to expand its fleet across Santa Maria, Oxnard, and Watsonville. TRIC Robotics is an agricultural robotics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Twig
providers.description: Twig (twig.bio) is a UK biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to design sustainable bioengineered ingredients — "AI defined ingredients that don't cost the earth." Its proprietary twig:tech platform pairs bio:drive, an AI/ML design engine that generates and scores novel microbe designs across pathway and enzyme selection, gene edits, and expression levels, with grow:bot, an automated high-throughput lab that builds and tests those designs and feeds every result back into the next design cycle. Twig aims to cultivate clean ingredients from bacteria via fermentation rather than extracting them from the ground or sea or producing them with fossil fuels. Twig is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is backed by additional early-stage investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; Twig currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface — its api./app. subdomains resolve to internal infrastructure — so this pass captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Westbound Equity Partners
providers.description: Westbound Equity Partners is a venture capital firm that invests financial and social capital into values-aligned founding teams, aiming to build a virtuous cycle of wealth and opportunity. The firm backs ventures across workplace equity and wealth-building, climate tech and decarbonization, AI and advanced technology, and social impact, and supports founders through the Westbound Network of entrepreneurs, operators, and investors plus culture coaching and talent services. Portfolio companies include Esusu, Planet FWD, Syndio, Sierra, Mon Ami, The Browser Company, Conduit Tech, Manas AI, and Laborup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Westbound publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Windfall Bio
providers.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: EPA.gov
providers.description: EPA.gov is an alias for the Environmental Protection Agency entry. The canonical APIs.json index for U.S. EPA APIs and data services is maintained in the environmental-protection-agency repository, which catalogs EPA's Envirofacts Data Service, Air Quality System (AQS), UV Index, and ECHO Compliance and Enforcement APIs. Refer to the canonical record for current API listings, properties, and metadata.

providers.name: Mighty Buildings
providers.description: Mighty Buildings is a construction-technology and advanced-manufacturing company that industrializes homebuilding using large-format 3D printing, proprietary polymer-composite materials and robotic automation. Founded in 2019 and originally based in Oakland, California, it raised more than $150 million from investors including Khosla Ventures, Bold Capital and Aramco's Wa'ed Ventures, and was the first company certified under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies, as well as being certified under California's Factory Built Housing program. Its current product is the Mighty Kit System / Mighty Wall System - factory-made complete wall panels that arrive on site with integrated structure, insulation, waterproofing and exterior finish, so builders assemble a building envelope with conventional methods and fewer on-site steps. After a January 2025 restructuring and sale process, the full suite of Mighty Buildings technologies was acquired by LUMUS Inc., and Mighty Buildings now operates as a LUMUS brand headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon. The company sells physical building systems to developers and builders; it operates no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Praan
providers.description: Praan (Praan Climate Technologies) is a deep-tech climate startup working to democratize access to clean, healthy air and to rebuild the atmosphere by capturing air pollution and greenhouse gases with novel filterless technology. Its products include HIVE, an air-purification device for homes and commercial spaces paired with a companion mobile application, and MK II, an air-purification system for industrial environments. Praan is backed by Prosus Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched through the API Evangelist pipeline; as of this pass Praan publishes a consumer hardware and mobile-app surface but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Sila Nanotechnologies
providers.description: Sila Nanotechnologies is a next-generation battery materials company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Alameda, California, with a commercial-scale manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington. Sila develops silicon-based anode materials — marketed as Titan Silicon — that replace conventional graphite anodes to increase the energy density of lithium-ion batteries used in consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and other applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8VC and Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sila is a physical materials and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture only.

providers.name: CarbonChain
providers.description: CarbonChain is a London- and New York-based carbon accounting platform founded in 2019 that is purpose-built for the highest-emitting, hardest-to- track commodity supply chains — metals and mining, energy, manufacturing, and agriculture. Its AI-assisted platform builds asset- and transaction- level emissions pictures using activity-based emission factors, and packages those calculations into modules for supply-chain emissions, corporate carbon footprints (Scope 1, 2, 3), product carbon footprints, scenario analysis, and regulatory compliance. The flagship CarbonChain Comply release ships a Carbon Reporting Hub aligned with EU CSRD, UK SECR, US SEC, and CDP, along with EU/UK CBAM declaration validation, automated CBAM XML generation, and a Supplier Engagement Module for collecting and validating supplier emissions data. CarbonChain Connect links producers and importers through shared installation-level CBAM infrastructure. The company is a CDP Accredited Provider (2024), is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by Y Combinator, Union Square Ventures, Voyager VC, and Aera VC, with $10M Series A funding (2023). CarbonChain serves manufacturers, commodity traders, banks, and procurement teams, and offers system-to-system API integration for delivering activity data in and pulling gold-standard emissions calculations out — but it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client library. API access is offered as part of customer integration projects rather than as a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: EnerVenue
providers.description: EnerVenue is a Fremont, California-based energy infrastructure company building long-duration stationary energy storage using a metal-hydrogen (nickel-hydrogen) battery chemistry derived from NASA-heritage technology that has powered the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station since the 1980s. Co-founded by Stanford materials scientist Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue refined the orbital nickel-hydrogen cell into a grid-scale "Energy Storage Vessel" (ESV) targeting a 30-year, 30,000+ cycle service life with 100% usable depth of discharge, ~90% round-trip efficiency, an operating range of -20 C to +60 C, no thermal runaway risk, and no active thermal management. The ESV's aqueous metal cell (AMC) uses a nickel hydroxide cathode, a nickel-alloy anode, an alkaline electrolyte, and hermetically sealed hydrogen gas storage built from steel, nickel, fiberglass, resin, and water — no lithium, cobalt, or rare earths. EnerVenue is scaling manufacturing through a one-million- square-foot gigafactory in Shelby County, Kentucky (1 GWh phase one, scaling toward 20 GWh per year with ~$1B of follow-on investment) plus a high-volume line in Changzhou, China (250 MWh by Q3 2026, 1 GWh in 2027). Customer commitments exceed 7 GWh and include Pine Gate Renewables (2.4 GWh, multi-year), Green Energy Renewable Solutions (Nicon Industries), Sonnell Power Solutions, and VedantaESS. The company closed a $300M Series B in 2026 to fund the gigafactory build-out. EnerVenue sells hardware, EPC-integrated storage systems, and long-duration service warranties — it does not publish a developer API, SDK, public OpenAPI specification, or open-source repository.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: Skyfri
providers.description: Skyfri is a cleantech software and hardware company headquartered in Oslo, Norway that builds an operating platform for owners and operators of solar and battery energy assets. Founded in 2021, Skyfri combines an edge-native monitoring and control device (the SSI hardware, which speaks Modbus and SCADA over isolated RS-485 ports to inverters, meters, and sensors) with a cloud platform that automates operations, maintenance, and asset performance management. The software delivers real-time data processing, operational management, weather forecasting, dynamic benchmarking, plant insights, and fault detection to monitor generation and address underperformance and equipment failure across a global portfolio of solar and battery assets. The company has offices in Denver, London, Oslo, Singapore, and Bangalore and is backed by Speedinvest. Skyfri exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; its platform is delivered as a customer application at app.skyfri.com.

providers.name: Urban Machine
providers.description: Urban Machine is a GV-backed robotics company building AI and computer-vision powered machines that remove metal fasteners (nails, staples, and screws) from construction and demolition lumber waste, reclaiming it for premium wood products and circular-economy reuse. The company publishes no public API, but maintains an open-source ROS/Python robotics tooling footprint on GitHub, including the colcon-poetry-ros package on PyPI.

providers.name: Alpine Bio
providers.description: Alpine Bio is a molecular-farming biotechnology company (formerly Nobell Foods and Alpine Roads), founded in 2016 and based in South San Francisco, California. It produces next-generation protein ingredients and bioactives from plants using advanced purification and molecular farming, having expressed more than 15 complex proteins including the world's first plant-derived casein, fractionated soy protein isolates, and activated iron-loaded lactoferrin. The company sells high-purity, clean-label ingredients to food and beverage formulators for applications such as protein shakes, bars, coffee creamers, iron supplements, yogurt, and clear protein sodas, and markets animal-free dairy products under the Nobell Foods brand. It is a portfolio company of a16z surfaced in the API Evangelist network; Alpine Bio publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Birdstop
providers.description: Birdstop is an American autonomous-drone and remote-sensing company that lets organizations monitor and inspect field assets at scale without personnel onsite. Its Fealty system is an all-weather, always-on drone that launches in under three seconds, flies for up to 45 minutes, cruises at 45 mph, and patrols 24/7 across public safety, utilities, transportation, construction, and data-center sites. Birdstop pairs networked UAVs and ground stations with computer vision and a patented optical/acoustic detect-and-avoid system to enable safe beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight under some of the FAA's most advanced approvals, delivering Observation-on-Demand intel over the internet. The company is FAA-authorized, SOC 2 certified, and NDAA compliant, and builds its drones in Detroit. Backed by Techstars, Birdstop currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Brimstone
providers.description: Brimstone is a materials technology company decarbonizing heavy industry through a single-rock co-production process it calls the Rock Refinery. From ordinary calcium silicate rock it extracts multiple high-value materials at once - carbon-negative Portland cement and supplementary cementitious materials, alumina and aluminum, magnesium, titanium, iron/steel feedstock and critical minerals - aiming to use 100% of the feed rock and eliminate tailings while cutting process emissions. The company uses commercially available equipment for a low-cost, market-ready approach, and has secured commitments including Amazon as a buyer of low-carbon cement from its first commercial plant. Brimstone is a private heavy-industry / climate-tech company backed by DCVC and Fifth Wall; it operates no public developer API.

providers.name: Cyclic Materials
providers.description: Cyclic Materials is a Kingston, Ontario cleantech company founded in 2021 that is building a circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. It recovers neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr), samarium, gadolinium, terbium and dysprosium from end-of-life magnet-containing products — electric-vehicle motors, wind-turbine generators, MRI machines and e-waste — using its proprietary MagCycle magnet-separation and REEPure refining processes, and supplies recycled mixed rare earth oxide (rMREO) and recycled copper back into automotive, data-centre, defence and energy manufacturing. The company operates a REEPure commercial demonstration plant and a MagCycle pilot in Kingston, with a Centre of Excellence under construction there and campuses planned in Arizona and South Carolina. It is a materials producer, not a software vendor: it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification, and its only public application surface is an Auth0-gated supplier portal for recyclers, aggregators and core buyers.

providers.name: EVERSTEEL
providers.description: EVERSTEEL is a University of Tokyo-originated startup building AI image-recognition systems that automate the inspection and grading of steel (iron) scrap for steelmakers. Its flagship product, Tetsu-Navi Inspection AI (鉄ナビ検収AI), uses high-resolution cameras and computer-vision models to grade incoming scrap, detect impurities and hazardous materials, and standardize what was previously a manual, expert-dependent process — advancing steel recycling and reducing CO2 emissions from steel production. The company works with major Japanese steel producers including JFE Steel and Kyoei Steel, and is backed by DCM Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Coreline, and the University of Tokyo.

providers.name: Formo
providers.description: Formo (Formo Foods GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company producing animal-free dairy through precision fermentation and microbial fermentation of koji (Aspergillus oryzae). Instead of cows, Formo engineers microorganisms to make milk proteins such as casein, which it turns into real cheese and cream cheese products now sold across Germany and Austria. Founded by Raffael Wohlgensinger and backed by EQT Ventures, the company has received a US FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for its fermentation-derived casein. Formo is a consumer food producer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hertha Metals
providers.description: Hertha Metals is a hard-technology steel production company based in Conroe, Texas, working to decarbonize and modernize primary steelmaking after centuries of coke-based blast-furnace iron and steel production. Founded by Laureen Meroueh, the company has developed proprietary pyrometallurgical HERS and Flex-HERS technology that produces steel from flexible feedstocks in a single reactor, and has raised roughly $17M toward a commercial steel plant. Hertha Metals is an industrial / climate-tech manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Plan A
providers.description: Plan A is a Berlin-headquartered enterprise sustainability software company, founded in 2017, building an end-to-end decarbonization platform for large organizations across Europe, the UK, and North America. The Plan A platform combines carbon accounting (Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions measurement aligned with the GHG Protocol), regulatory reporting (CSRD / ESRS, EU Taxonomy, CSDDD, UK SDR, US SEC climate disclosure, CBAM), and decarbonization planning (science-based target setting, abatement modelling, and forecasting). Customers include Sorare, KFC, Visa, BMW, Alphabet, and Mollie, served from offices in Berlin, Paris, and London. The platform is TUV Rheinland-certified and the company is a certified B Corporation. Plan A markets a Carbon Scanner, a Decarbonisation Savings Calculator, an Academy, a Whitepaper Centre, and a Regulation Centre as public-facing surfaces; the core carbon-accounting and reporting product is sold via enterprise contract and is not exposed as a public developer API. Plan A references "custom APIs" for client data integration in case-study material, but does not publish a developer portal, an OpenAPI specification, a public SDK, or an open-source GitHub organization. There is therefore no self-serve API surface to profile; this entry indexes Plan A as a decarbonization-platform provider for the API Evangelist sustainability landscape.

providers.name: Pretred
providers.description: Pretred is a Techstars-backed manufacturer of sustainable rubber safety barriers made from recycled waste tires, serving the infrastructure, traffic control, and construction sectors with a circular-economy model. Its product line spans the Standard Rubber Barrier, TL-2 and TL-3 crash-tested barriers, a Load-Rated Barrier rated for heavy machinery, and Paceline bike-lane barriers, each engineered for energy absorption, durability, and modularity. Every Pretred facility can divert over 100 million pounds of waste tires from landfills or incineration annually. As a physical-goods manufacturer, Pretred publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures the company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: RefineRE
providers.description: RefineRE is a commercial real estate (CRE) SaaS platform that unifies benchmarking, data analysis, and portfolio usage tools into a single product suite for corporate real estate teams. Its eight modules span data foundations, portfolio management, market analysis, ESG tracking, and workplace analytics, helping occupiers and CRE managers optimize their real estate portfolios. A Techstars-backed company, RefineRE is added to the API Evangelist network as a provider profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Smallhold
providers.description: Smallhold is a specialty organic mushroom company founded in 2017 by Andrew Carter and Adam DeMartino and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. A Certified B Corporation, Smallhold grows gourmet mushroom varieties — including blue oyster, lion's mane, maitake, royal trumpet, and shiitake — using modular, automated "minifarm" growing environments designed for distributed, locally grown supply to grocery retailers and restaurants. Its public presence is a direct-to-consumer and retail-partner storefront built on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and run through the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed no bespoke API surface — only Shopify's platform OAuth discovery documents are exposed on the shop domain.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Notco
providers.description: NotCo (The Not Company) is a food-technology company founded in 2015 in Santiago, Chile that uses artificial intelligence — its proprietary "Giuseppe" platform — to reverse-engineer animal-based foods from plant ingredients. Its consumer brand at notco.com sells plant-based products including NotMilk, NotMayo, NotBurger and NotIceCream across the Americas, while NotCo AI (notco.ai) licenses the Giuseppe AI R&D platform to global CPG manufacturers such as PepsiCo, Magnum and Barry Callebaut to accelerate food-product innovation. The company is backed by General Catalyst and other investors. NotCo publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its corporate, product, AI-platform and trust/compliance web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Finless Foods
providers.description: Finless Foods is an Emeryville, California cellular-agriculture company founded in 2017 by Michael Selden and Brian Wyrwas to grow real seafood from fish cells instead of harvesting it from the ocean. Its scientists established proprietary marine cell lines and a culture-media and bioreactor process that cultivates bluefin tuna and other high-value species into three-dimensional tissue with comparable taste, texture and nutrition to wild-caught fish, and the company has also shipped a plant-based tuna alternative into foodservice while the cell-cultivated line moves toward regulatory clearance and commercial launch.
