providers.description: Forever Oceans Corporation was a US offshore aquaculture company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Virginia, that raised sushi-grade kanpachi (Seriola rivoliana) in deep water off the Pacific coast of Panama using a patented single-point mooring system that let its submerged pens orient with ocean currents. It raised roughly $170M and held a large Brazilian marine-aquaculture concession, with planned farms in Brazil and Indonesia. Its investors brought in restructuring and liquidation specialists in November 2024, and its corporate domain foreveroceans.com is now a registrar parking page that refuses HTTPS. Seafood production, not software, was the product: the company never published an API, developer portal, SDK or any machine-readable contract, and no such surface survives.

providers.name: Cowboy Clean Fuels
providers.description: Cowboy Clean Fuels (CCF) is a Denver, Colorado climate-technology company, founded in 2020 and operating in Gillette, Wyoming, that produces carbon-negative renewable natural gas (RNG) while permanently sequestering atmospheric carbon dioxide. CCF injects non-food-grade organic biomass — residue products of sugar-beet refining such as molasses — into depleted coal bed methane (CBM) wells in the Powder River Basin, where naturally occurring methanogenic microorganisms convert the feedstock into methane and carbon dioxide; the coal seam then selectively adsorbs and permanently stores the CO2. Its lead development is the Triangle Unit Renewable Energy and Carbon Capture and Storage Project (TRECCS) near Gillette, Wyoming, and in May 2025 it signed an offtake agreement with Mercuria for RNG produced under its BiCRS+RNG methodology. Cowboy Clean Fuels is an energy and carbon-dioxide-removal operator, not a software vendor: it sells molecules and carbon removal credits, and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: abillion
providers.description: abillion was a Singapore-based social platform and mobile app for discovering and reviewing vegan, sustainable, and cruelty-free products across food, beauty, and fashion, pairing a large consumer review community with a rewards model that converted member reviews into donations to non-profits and animal sanctuaries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. NOTE: as of July 2026 the abillion platform has officially shut down ("abillion is closing its doors"); the public site serves only a farewell notice and states member data is archived for six months before permanent deletion. No public developer program, API, or discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: AgLocal
providers.description: AgLocal was a venture-backed food-technology startup (founded 2011 by Mike Hsieh and Naithan Jones, Kansas City / San Francisco) that built an online marketplace connecting small family ranchers and sustainable meat producers directly with buyers. It launched in 2013 as a ranch-to-restaurant marketplace serving chefs, then pivoted in 2014 to a consumer-facing monthly meat subscription service. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Chicago Ventures and others across roughly $3.8M in funding, the company shut down in 2015, stating it could not reach a self-sustaining business model. It is added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead; the company is now defunct and its domain (aglocal.com) is parked/for sale, so no live developer portal, API, or specifications exist to enrich.

providers.name: Albedo
providers.description: Albedo is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: frontier-tech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: BANIQL CORP.
providers.description: BANIQL CORP. (BANiQL) is developing a sustainable process for selectively extracting nickel and cobalt for use in lithium-ion battery production. Its core technology uses a chemical process to selectively extract nickel and cobalt from raw materials at lower temperatures and atmospheric pressure, producing high-quality nickel at roughly 30% lower cost than High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) with net-zero waste, cutting energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by around 80% while repurposing leftover materials into products like fertilizers and construction materials. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; this materials/cleantech company publishes no developer or API surface, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Brilliant Planet
providers.description: Brilliant Planet is a carbon-removal company that grows microalgae in open-air ponds on otherwise-unproductive coastal desert land, using seawater rather than fresh water, to sequester atmospheric carbon dioxide at scale. Harvested algal biomass is dried and stored to lock the captured carbon away durably, while the process also deacidifies the seawater it returns. The company operates research and demonstration facilities in coastal Morocco and is developing measurement, reporting, and verification approaches for its nature-based carbon capture. It is backed by Union Square Ventures and other climate-focused investors. This API Evangelist profile is a company/provider record; Brilliant Planet publishes no public developer API or documentation surface at this time (its primary web presence is access-restricted).

providers.name: C16 Biosciences
providers.description: C16 Biosciences is a New York City based synthetic biology company producing high-performance, sustainable ingredients for consumer goods manufacturers through its proprietary Palmless platform. Using microbial fermentation and biotechnology, C16 designs plant-free, deforestation-free alternatives to palm oil and petroleum-derived commodity ingredients for beauty and personal care, food, and home and personal care markets. Its flagship Palmless Torula Oil is a bioactive super-emollient with antioxidant properties for skincare formulations, alongside designer fats, oils, fatty acids, triglycerides, and alcohols. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCVC; it is an ingredients and biomanufacturing business and does not currently publish a public developer platform or API.

providers.name: Chart Industries
providers.description: Chart Industries is a leading global manufacturer of highly engineered equipment servicing multiple market applications in clean energy and industrial gas. The company provides cryogenic equipment, process technologies, and aftermarket services for hydrogen, LNG, biogas, CO2 capture, and traditional industrial gases. Chart Industries does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Commercial Metals Company
providers.description: Commercial Metals Company (CMC) is a Fortune 500 manufacturer, recycler, and marketer of steel and metal products serving the construction, energy, and manufacturing industries. CMC was the first US steel company to launch an online customer portal (myCMC), but does not currently publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI specifications. Programmatic integrations with myCMC (order management, shipping, invoicing) are typically established through direct contracts with CMC's IT organization rather than via a self-service developer program.

providers.name: Cultivaet Technologies Holding Ltd.
providers.description: Cultivaet Technologies Holding Ltd. is an AI-driven agricultural technology ("AgriTech for Humanity") startup based in Egypt serving smallholder farmers across the Middle East. Its products include a Farmer AI Companion delivering personalized weather, crop-planning, pest-control and soil-health insights, a Knowledge Platform that collects/analyzes/distributes social and scientific agricultural data, and a Business SaaS connecting farmers with food-industry buyers for sustainable procurement and traceability. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sanabil and is part of the Google Cloud Startups Program (pre-seed, 2024). As of this enrichment pass Cultivaet publishes only a marketing site (cultivaet.ai) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or other developer surface, so no API artifacts were generated.

providers.name: Ecobites Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: Ecobites Pte. Ltd. operates Rec Rec, a Vietnamese consumer packaged-goods brand producing cricket-based snack foods marketed as high-protein, nutrient-dense alternatives to conventional snacks. Its product line spans cricket noodles (Mi Dam De), cricket puffs (Banh Phong De) in flavors such as Gochujang and Mala, and seasoned dried crickets (De Say). Products emphasize complete protein with a full amino-acid profile plus iron, zinc, magnesium, and potassium while keeping sodium low. Rec Rec is distributed through 7-Eleven, Farmers Market, Galaxy Cinema, BHD Cineplex, Naman Market, LS Place, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. It publishes a consumer e-commerce website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Ecolab
providers.description: Ecolab is a Fortune 500 global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services. The company helps customers in food, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and energy markets keep their environments clean, safe, and healthy while protecting people and vital resources.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Enviri (formerly Harsco)
providers.description: Enviri Corporation, formerly known as Harsco Corporation, is a trusted global leader in environmental solutions, developing and refining methods of recycling and beneficial reuse for industrial customers. Enviri operates through three divisions: Clean Earth (hazardous waste management and recycling), Harsco Environmental (services to the global steel industry), and Harsco Rail (rail-track maintenance equipment and services). Enviri does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Faircraft
providers.description: Faircraft is a biotechnology company creating a new class of cultivated materials, starting with real leather grown in the lab from animal cells rather than raised on farms. Using cell biology and protein engineering, it produces genuine leather (product lines FCL_001 through FCL_006) with the look, feel, and performance of traditional hides but with a lower environmental footprint and no animal farming, and customizable properties for fashion, automotive, and luxury brands. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Faircraft is a materials-science company with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: GAGO Group
providers.description: GAGO Group (Beijing Jiage Tianyu Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China-based frontier-technology company focused on agricultural and rural big data applications. Its homepage positions the business around agricultural and rural big data, applying remote-sensing and data-analytics techniques to agriculture. GAGO Group is backed by DCM Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate website at gagogroup.cn but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be verified, so no spec-derived API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: Givemetap
providers.description: GiveMeTap is a UK-based social-enterprise consumer brand that designs and sells reusable, BPA-free stainless-steel and insulated water bottles (500ml and 700ml, plus custom co-branded bottles for businesses). For every bottle sold, GiveMeTap funds five years of clean drinking water for a person in Ghana, giving 20% of its revenue to water projects in Africa; the company reports 116,391 people reached with clean water for life. It operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront on the Shopify platform. GiveMeTap is a physical-products company with no first-party developer API, developer portal, or public API documentation; it was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub.

providers.name: graphenest.com
providers.description: Graphenest is a Portuguese nano-cleantech company that develops sustainable, high-performance graphene-based materials for electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC/RF) shielding. Its proprietary, scalable and low-energy graphene production process powers two industrial-ready product lines: HexaShield, a sprayable conductive coating for high-frequency applications, and G-Shield, a family of conductive thermoplastics for extrusion and injection moulding, plus the G-Prime graphene material. The solutions deliver higher shielding performance at lower cost and weight (up to 75% lighter than metal alternatives) for Tier 1/Tier 2 manufacturers in batteries, electronics, telecom (radar, LiDAR, 5G/6G), and cables & wires. Graphenest is a materials and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars-linked portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Greif
providers.description: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world. Greif also offers digital tools such as the Greif Green Tool carbon footprint calculator and the Greif+ online platform for customers.

providers.name: infarm
providers.description: infarm (Indoor Urban Farming GmbH) is a Berlin-based vertical/indoor farming company, surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company builds modular, cloud-connected growing systems for herbs, leafy greens, and produce placed in grocery stores and distribution hubs. This profile was enriched by the pipeline; infarm publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface, and its website is bot-blocked (HTTP 403) to automated access, so only domain-level security posture could be probed. It remains a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: jsgaiya
providers.description: Jiangsu Gaiya Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. (江苏盖亚环境工程有限公司) is a Suzhou-based environmental engineering and technology company, described on its site as the region's first firm specializing in contaminated-soil remediation, with offices at the Nanjing University Suzhou High-Tech Research Institute. Its business covers environmental engineering design and construction, environmental testing and risk assessment, R&D and sale of environmental-protection equipment, product distribution, and environmental technology consulting. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network. Enrichment probes found a static Chinese-language marketing website (IIS, GB2312) and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Kairos Aerospace
providers.description: Kairos Aerospace is a methane-detection company founded in 2014 in Sunnyvale, California that provides cost-effective, high-frequency aerial methane detection for the oil and gas industry. Its patented LeakSurveyor spectrometer is flown over upstream and midstream infrastructure to image methane plumes, and proprietary software turns those flights into actionable emissions data so operators can find, prioritize, and fix leaks. The company rebranded as Insight M in March 2024 and was subsequently acquired by Zeitview. Kairos Aerospace was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile is an identity record rather than an API catalog entry.

providers.name: Lunasonde
providers.description: Lunasonde is a Techstars-backed deep-tech space company building a satellite constellation for subsurface Earth imaging. Its sensing technology aims to scan beneath the surface from orbit to detect groundwater, minerals, and other underground features, delivering the resulting geophysical data to mining, agriculture, water, and natural-resource customers. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its verifiable web and domain-security footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mantari
providers.description: Mantari is a weather-intelligence and earth-sensing company building a decision-intelligence platform that fuses a distributed network of sensors with AI to turn environmental data across oceans, skies, and space into mission-critical, actionable intelligence. It initially targets government and defense decision support, with plans to extend into broader economic and commercial applications. As of this profile Mantari publishes a marketing homepage and a careers page but no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; this record captures its identity plus a live domain-security probe, pending a future developer surface.

providers.name: microTERRA
providers.description: microTERRA is a Mexico-based food-ingredient company that develops functional ingredients derived from Lemna (duckweed). Its MAS product line delivers natural flavor enhancers and texture modifiers for the food and beverage industry, positioned as sustainable, clean-label alternatives that support salt and sugar reduction in formulations. A Techstars-backed B2B startup, microTERRA sells to food formulators and manufacturers and does not currently expose any public developer API, SDK, CLI, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Module
providers.description: Module is a vertically integrated sustainable housing company that designs, manufactures, and builds modular homes. Operating across design (architecture and engineering with BIM), manufacturing (its Last Mile Facility in Pittsburgh), and construction (licensed general contracting), Module focuses on infill and "missing middle" housing, small-footprint and energy-efficient affordable homes, and mixed-income developments through its Last Mile Network of design, construction, and mission-driven developer partner programs. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; Module publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Molagri
providers.description: Molagri is a Toronto-based biotechnology startup building next-generation biopesticides for agriculture. The company designs pest-control molecules that target specific molecular pathways unique to pest insects while preserving pollinators and other beneficial organisms, and uses predictive modeling to stay ahead of the evolution of pest resistance. Molagri emphasizes higher efficacy and biobased production to reduce emissions across both manufacturing and field application. Founded in 2026 by University of Toronto PhD biochemists Zaky Hassan and Min Jin, the company was part of the Y Combinator Summer 2026 batch. It was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking; as an early-stage biotech it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Mushroom Material
providers.description: Mushroom Material is a New Zealand and Singapore based sustainable-packaging startup founded in 2020 by Shaun Seaman and Jotinder Singh that grows a biodegradable, home-compostable alternative to expanded polystyrene (Styrofoam) from fungal mycelium. The company combines agricultural byproducts such as wood chips, sawdust, hemp straw and cardboard with mycelium to grow millions of pellets, coats them in a biopolymer binder, and uses compression molding to shape protective packaging that drops into existing Styrofoam production lines. The material offers shock absorption, low density and natural water resistance while composting in months. A Techstars-backed company, Mushroom Material raised a US$5M+ (NZ$8.5M) seed round led by Wavemaker Partners and Singapore's SEEDS Capital (with Icehouse Ventures, K1W1 and Black Kite Capital) to build a pilot plant in Auckland. This profile is a materials/manufacturing company in the API Evangelist network; it has no public API surface.

providers.name: Mycoworks
providers.description: MycoWorks is a San Francisco Bay Area biotechnology and advanced-materials company founded in 2013 by artist Philip Ross and Sophia Wang, headquartered in Emeryville, California. It engineers premium leather-alternative biomaterials from mycelium using its patented Fine Mycelium process, sold under the Reishi brand to luxury fashion, automotive, and design partners. The company was backed by DCVC and other investors; it entered insolvency and was wound down through an Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors in late 2025. MycoWorks operates as a physical-materials manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal, so this API Evangelist profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Nexus Lab Technologies, Inc.
providers.description: Nexus Lab (Nexus Lab Technologies, Inc.) is a contrail-reduction software company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. Operating from nexuslab.fr, it applies machine learning to satellite imagery, flight traffic data, and meteorological parameters to help airlines optimize flight paths and reduce contrail formation, mitigating aviation's non-CO2 climate impact. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a marketing website with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; no developer surface was found to catalog.

providers.name: Nosh Bio
providers.description: Nosh.bio is a Berlin-based sustainable food-technology company founded in 2022 by Tim Fronzek and Felipe Lino that produces nutritional, highly functional proteins from non-GMO fungi via proprietary precision fermentation. Its flagship Koji Protein and Koji-Beef mince hybrid are mycelium-derived, clean-label mycoprotein ingredients with binding, gelling and texturizing properties, sold B2B to manufacturers across meat alternatives, seafood, dairy, sauces, confectionery, wellness and pet food. The company is a foodtech portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital and closed a EUR 3.2M seed round. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Nosh.bio publishes no developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: Omeat
providers.description: Omeat (rebranded as Evergreen Select) is a cultivated-beef company that partners with global meat producers to create price-predictable, industrial-scale beef supply. It produces 100% real beef without antibiotics, hormones, or plant-based fillers, positioning cultivated meat as a practical supplement to conventional supply chains while holding pricing at parity with commodity ground beef. Founded by tissue-engineering researcher Ali Khademhosseini and backed by GV, the company targets restaurants and meat processors seeking supply-chain stability and consistent quality. As of this enrichment pass Omeat operates as a food/biotech producer with a marketing website only: no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found, so there is no machine-readable API surface to catalog. This profile is retained as a company/lead record surfaced from the GV venture portfolio.

providers.name: Omniscient
providers.description: Omniscient is an AI intelligence platform for organizational decision-making, describing itself as a new class of AI that masters an organization's data and context to deliver decision-moving insights. Its focus areas include corporate reputation and narrative monitoring, geopolitical and regulatory risk tracking, marketing and narrative measurement, and supply chain and ESG risk, with an emphasis on early detection of weak signals and coordinated response. A Seedcamp portfolio company, it is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site (Azure Static Web Apps) with no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: OpenInvest
providers.description: OpenInvest was a values-based / ESG investing fintech (Y Combinator and a16z backed) that let advisors and investors build and manage portfolios aligned to social and environmental causes. It was acquired by J.P. Morgan Chase in 2021 and folded into J.P. Morgan's wealth-management and Private Bank offerings. Its standalone product and any developer surface were discontinued: the openinvest.com domain now resolves to J.P. Morgan (www.openinvest.com is a CNAME to privatebank.jpmorgan.com), and no public OpenInvest developer portal, documentation, API reference, SDKs, or .well-known metadata could be found during enrichment. Retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company record with no live API surface.

providers.name: Orbicle Bio
providers.description: Orbicle Bio is an agricultural biotechnology startup developing carbon-negative, microbial-based organic fertilizers derived from soil microbes to replace synthetic fertilizers. Backed by 500 Global, the company targets rice-farming productivity and soil sustainability across Southeast Asian markets such as Vietnam and Thailand, with a commercial product launch planned for 2026. Orbicle Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness and enrichment.

providers.name: Packfleet
providers.description: Packfleet was an all-electric last-mile parcel courier based in London, delivering for hundreds of merchant customers using a zero-emission electric-van fleet with a focus on sustainable, reliable next-day delivery. Backed by Creandum as a venture-funded climate-logistics company, Packfleet wound down its independent brand in March 2025, with its deliveries transitioned to DHL. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was ever published; this profile is retained as a network record. Enriched: no API surface (company now operates as DHL).

providers.name: Phoenix Tailings
providers.description: Phoenix Tailings is a clean rare earth and critical minerals refining company working to restore U.S. industrial independence by building domestic refining capacity for the metals behind every major technology. It recovers rare earth elements and other critical minerals from mining waste (tailings) and low-grade feedstocks using a low-emission, zero-landfill process, supplying materials for medical devices, electric vehicles and automotive systems, electronics, and defense applications. The company operates as a materials producer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Phood Solutions
providers.description: Phood Solutions is a New York City-based food-waste technology company founded in 2015 by Luc Dang and Nick Kruczek. Its computer-vision platform, PhoodX, pairs a countertop scale and camera system with a waste-analytics dashboard to automatically identify, weigh, and categorize discarded food in commercial kitchens, grocery prepared-foods operations, and food-service venues. The platform reports product-level margins, recommends demand-based production volumes, and helps operators cut food waste by up to 50 percent, reduce kitchen labor, and lower food-inventory costs. Phood also offers Phood Lab, custom digital solutions built by its food technologists. The company is backed by Techstars. Phood publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Planetly
providers.description: Planetly was a Berlin-based carbon accounting and climate software startup, backed by speedinvest, that helped companies measure, reduce, and offset their carbon footprint. It was acquired by OneTrust and subsequently absorbed; as of this enrichment pass the planetly.com domain 301-redirects to onetrust.com/solutions, and Planetly operates no independent website, developer portal, or public API surface. This profile is retained as a network stub documenting the company and its outcome.

providers.name: PwC
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms providing audit and assurance, tax, and management consulting services globally. PwC operates as a network of member firms across approximately 150 countries with hundreds of thousands of professionals. Service lines include audit, deals and transactions, tax compliance and advisory, risk assurance, cybersecurity and privacy, ESG and sustainability assurance, workforce transformation, and digital/technology consulting (cloud, data, AI, ERP). PwC publishes thought-leadership content and operates client portals for engagement delivery and document exchange, but it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level - client connectivity is bilateral and project-scoped rather than offered as a self-serve API product.

providers.name: Rise Reforming
providers.description: Rise Reforming is a climate-technology company that converts underutilized and flared waste biogas into valuable chemicals such as dimethyl ether (DME) and methanol. It deploys a modular, on-site reforming process at biogas sources like wastewater treatment plants, enabling localized, supply-secure chemical production and reducing dependence on centralized, fossil-fuel-based chemical manufacturing. A Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company, it is building the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demonstration in the Americas at a Chicagoland wastewater facility. As a hardware and chemical-process company, it currently publishes no public web API, developer portal, or software SDK surface.

providers.name: Roadrunner
providers.description: RoadRunner is a tech-enabled managed waste and recycling services company operating across all 50 US states, serving 14,000+ commercial customers in hospitality, healthcare, retail, logistics and manufacturing. It consolidates multi-location waste programs and layers proprietary optimization tooling (Oversite, Waste Metering, BillCheck, Priceshield) plus the RecycleMORE and CleanStream recycling programs on top of hauler networks. Backed by Fifth Wall and Kleiner Perkins in the climate sector. As of this enrichment pass RoadRunner publishes a marketing site and a customer + payment portal but no public developer/API surface, so no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP or event artifacts were found.

providers.name: Rothys
providers.description: Rothy's is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer footwear and accessories brand founded in 2012, known for washable shoes and bags 3D-knitted from recycled materials such as post-consumer plastic water bottles and marine plastics. Its catalog spans flats, loafers, sneakers, Mary Janes, clogs, sandals, heels, and boots for women, men, and kids, alongside totes, crossbody bags, wallets, and backpacks. The company ships to 40+ countries and emphasizes sustainable, seamless-knit manufacturing that reduces waste. Rothy's was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and web presence for the catalog.

providers.name: Rtv
providers.description: Rtv (Return to Vendor) is a materials-innovation company building a circular recycling system for nylon-6. Its patented molecular design regenerates nylon that can be recycled infinitely without quality loss, yielding production-ready recyclable yarn, monomaterial stretch fabric, and regenerated pellets for injection molding and extrusion. The company also offers end-of-life textile collection, waste reprocessing, and regulatory-compliance support (EPR, California SB 707, EU textile regulations) for apparel, automotive, and technical industrial applications. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Third Sphere, Teknor Apex, and NSF SBIR grants.

providers.name: Shellworks
providers.description: Shellworks is a materials-science company that produces VIVOMER, a home-compostable, biodegradable alternative to conventional plastic made through a natural fermentation process from agricultural waste. VIVOMER runs on standard plastic-manufacturing equipment, is certified for food contact (FDA and EU 10/2011), and biodegrades without leaving microplastics or toxic residue. Shellworks supplies these sustainable packaging materials to consumer brands across the UK, EU, and US. Backed by Version One Ventures, the company was surfaced as a portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2B climate / materials supplier with no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Skybox Imaging
providers.description: Skybox Imaging was a high-resolution Earth-observation smallsat startup founded in 2009 out of Stanford University, building the SkySat constellation of small satellites to capture sub-meter commercial imagery and video. Backed by Canaan Partners among other venture investors, it was acquired by Google in 2014 for roughly $500M, renamed Terra Bella in 2016, and then sold to Planet Labs in 2017. The company no longer exists as an independent entity and publishes no live developer API, docs, or discovery surface; this profile is retained as a portfolio-graph node for canaan-partners.

providers.name: Skyboximaging
providers.description: Skybox Imaging was a satellite imaging and geospatial-analytics company (founded 2009, Mountain View, CA) that built a constellation of small high-resolution Earth-observation satellites (SkySat) and the analytics to turn frequent imagery into commercial insight. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Bessemer, Khosla Ventures and others, it was acquired by Google in 2014 (~$500M), renamed Terra Bella, and its satellite business was sold to Planet Labs in 2017. The skyboximaging.com domain is no longer a live product surface; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph and historical reference.

providers.name: Solugen
providers.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Terra Bella (fka Skybox Imaging)
providers.description: Terra Bella, originally founded in 2009 as Skybox Imaging (Mountain View, California), was a satellite imaging and geospatial analytics company that built and operated the SkySat constellation of high-resolution Earth-observation satellites. Google acquired Skybox Imaging in 2014 for roughly $500 million and rebranded it Terra Bella. In 2017 Alphabet/Google sold Terra Bella and its SkySat satellites to Planet Labs, folding the business into Planet's Earth-observation operations. Terra Bella no longer exists as an independent operating entity and publishes no independent developer portal, API, or SDK surface; its capabilities live on inside Planet Labs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners.

providers.name: The RealReal
providers.description: The RealReal is the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, operating a managed consignment marketplace across women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, handbags, fine art, and home. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company employs in-house gemologists, horologists, art curators, and brand authenticators to verify every item, pairing that expertise with data-driven pricing and demand insights. The RealReal is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: REAL) and has processed tens of millions of consigned items. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass The RealReal publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: The Rounds
providers.description: The Rounds was a membership-based sustainable grocery and household-goods delivery startup (backed by a16z and Redpoint Ventures) built around reusable packaging and reducing single-use waste. The company has since been wound down and folded into Misfits Market — as of this enrichment pass https://www.therounds.co/ returns an HTTP 301 redirect to a Misfits Market "welcome-new-rounds" landing page ("Same Mission, More Groceries"). No developer portal, API, documentation, or public API surface was found; api./docs./developer.therounds.co do not resolve. This profile is retained as a network lead with an acquired/defunct status.

providers.name: Three Wheels United
providers.description: Three Wheels United is a fintech-driven electric vehicle financing company in India, founded in 2017 by Cedrick Tandong, Kevin Wervenbos, and Apurv Mehra. It works to remove the financial barriers to clean mobility by providing loans for two- and three-wheeler electric vehicles — starting with auto-rickshaws — disbursed through its RBI-registered NBFC lending partner Shabri Investments Private Limited. The company pairs credit with a mobile app that helps drivers manage their loans and connect to services, and reports over 4,000 vehicles financed, 20,000+ customers served, and thousands of tonnes of CO2 reduced across Bangalore, Mumbai, and the Delhi NCR (Noida) region. It is backed by Techstars, Delta Corp Holdings, Asian Development Bank Ventures, Microsoft, and other global investors, having raised roughly $10 million in Series A funding. It is a consumer-facing lender with no public developer program, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Tidal Metals
providers.description: Tidal Metals is a deep-tech materials company that extracts decarbonized magnesium directly from seawater and desalination brine using only electricity from renewable sources, without mining, chemical additives, or brine waste. The company's patented process concentrates and extracts magnesium salt to address a critical supply-chain vulnerability: the United States currently produces no primary magnesium while China controls roughly 91% of global supply. Founded by Ph.D. physicists and engineers with backgrounds in nuclear engineering and plasma physics from MIT, Princeton, and Wisconsin-Madison, and backed by DCVC, Tidal Metals aims for carbon-neutral, domestically scalable magnesium production. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface at this time.

providers.name: Toasty
providers.description: Toasty (toasty.family, published by Wenose) is a French consumer mobile application for responsible, sustainable, and ethical shopping. The app curates committed brands and makes conscious consumption engaging through a gamified experience of daily private sales, quizzes, challenges, gifts, and rewards. It reports a 4.9-star rating across the app stores and more than 400,000 downloads. Toasty is a business-to-consumer mobile product with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at this time; it was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. This profile captures its public identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Tradesy
providers.description: Tradesy was a Los Angeles-based online marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned luxury and designer fashion, founded in 2009 and backed by 500 Global among others. In March 2022 it was acquired by Paris-based Vestiaire Collective to accelerate that company's expansion into the US resale market, and the standalone Tradesy brand was subsequently wound down. The tradesy.com domain now redirects to vestiairecollective.com, and Tradesy no longer operates an independent website, developer program, or public API. This profile is retained as a historical/acquired-company record.

providers.name: Ursa Space Systems
providers.description: Ursa Space Systems is an Ithaca, New York-based geospatial intelligence company that turns commercial satellite data — primarily Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, combined with electro-optical, RF, AIS, and other ground-truth feeds — into decision-ready insight reports. The company operates a GeoAI platform branded "From pixels to insights" that fuses 90+ geospatial data sources and ingests imagery from a global network of commercial SAR and EO satellite operators, then applies in-house remote-sensing, data science, and GIS expertise to deliver answers about what is happening on the ground at specific places and times. Ursa Space serves U.S. Government customers — including U.S. Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) under INDOPACOM, AFRICOM, and SOUTHCOM, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) under the Luno A and Luno B delivery orders, the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), and humanitarian-aid agencies — as well as commercial enterprise customers in energy, commodities, supply chain, maritime, and insurance. Reporting domains span security and defense (border monitoring, military activity, maritime, dark-vessel and ship-to-ship transfer detection, airstrip monitoring), environmental and disaster response (deforestation, earthquakes, flooding, wildfires), and infrastructure and industry monitoring (construction, mining, oil and gas supply chain, power generation, space situational awareness). The platform is currently in beta and Ursa Space does not operate a public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, SDK, or self-service signup; engagement is sales-led through contact@ursaspace.com and tailored to government and enterprise contracts.

providers.name: Vinterior
providers.description: Vinterior is a UK-based curated online marketplace for vintage, antique, and pre-owned furniture and homeware. It connects independent sellers, dealers, and restorers with buyers looking for one-of-a-kind pieces, positioning itself as a more sustainable alternative to mass-produced furniture. The platform handles product discovery, listings, seller storefronts, checkout, and delivery for design-led vintage goods. Vinterior is backed by Seedcamp. As of this profile Vinterior does not publish a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

providers.name: ViridiCO2
providers.description: ViridiCO2 is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: sustainability. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Zwitterco
providers.description: ZwitterCo is an advanced water treatment company that manufactures filtration membranes based on zwitterionic chemistry, a surface science that makes membranes attract water rather than organic compounds and thereby resist the organic fouling that limits conventional membranes. Its product families target food and dairy processing (Evolution membranes for whey and milk concentration), industrial and municipal wastewater (Elevation membranes for landfill leachate, refinery streams, and produced water), and extreme high-fouling waste streams (Expedition superfiltration). ZwitterCo is a DCVC portfolio company. It sells physical membrane hardware and treatment systems through direct sales and does not currently publish any public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable interface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Hillenbrand
providers.description: Hillenbrand is a global manufacturer of highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and systems serving the plastics, food, and recycling industries. The company operates across more than 60 global locations with a portfolio of leading industrial brands. Hillenbrand reports approximately $2.7 billion in annual revenue and employs over 8,000 associates worldwide.

providers.name: Kwest
providers.description: Kwest was a Berlin-based B2B SaaS platform for the operations behind renewable-energy installations. Founded by Robin Dechant, Marco Holst and Constantin Ehren, it gave solar, heat-pump and smart-meter installers a workflow platform covering project management, inspection documentation, automated report creation and incident management, plus integrations that synced installation data with the CRM, ERP and field-service tools those companies already ran (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Dynamics 365, Odoo, Xentral, weclapp, Zoho, Aurora Solar, Solytic, Praxedo, Zapier and others). Speedinvest invested in 2021. In 2024 Kwest was acquired by Kraken Technologies, the technology arm of Octopus Energy Group, which folded the Kwest workflow platform into the Kraken stack and opened its first development hub in Berlin around the seven-person team. Kwest published no public API or developer program, and the company no longer operates independently - its former getkwest.com domain has lapsed and now serves unrelated third-party content, so it is recorded here as historical only and is not linked as a live website.

providers.name: Sylvamo
providers.description: Sylvamo is a global producer of uncoated freesheet paper, pulp, and other forest products, with mills and operations across North America, Latin America, and Europe. The company is recognized for brands such as HP Papers, Hammermill, and Chamex. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; Sylvamo operates primarily through B2B sales channels and investor and corporate communications channels.

providers.name: Buildscience
providers.description: BuildScience Inc. (Y Combinator Winter 2015) was a PropTech startup based in Mountain View, California that built an operating-system platform for commercial buildings. Its software let building owners and facility operators deploy customized building-management solutions intended to reduce operational costs while improving tenant satisfaction, and the company reported deploying in a one-million-square-foot Class A office building. As of the 2026 enrichment pass the company appears dormant: the buildscience.com domain no longer serves a live product (the host returns a CloudFront default certificate that does not match the domain and a broken origin), no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface could be located, and the organization's single public GitHub repository was last updated in January 2020. This profile is retained as a verified-identity network record; no API artifacts could be enriched because the provider publishes no live API.

providers.name: Nanogrid
providers.description: Nanogrid was an Oakland, California software startup founded in 2017 by Patrick Sheehan (CEO), Jon McKay (Co-Founder & CPO), and Dan Lopuch (Co-Founder & CTO) that built software to determine the value of residential solar, battery storage, and electric vehicles for homeowners. Its platform simulated, estimated, and optimized these distributed energy resources and captured the operational synergies between the devices. A 500 Startups (500 Global) Batch 25 company, Nanogrid raised roughly $150K from 500 Global and Plug and Play Tech Center before being acquired by clean-energy company Arcadia on April 22, 2021. The company no longer operates independently and its nanogrid.tech domain no longer resolves; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical portfolio-lead record. (Not to be confused with the separate nanoGrid energy-data platform at nanogrid.com.)

providers.name: Fervo Energy
providers.description: Fervo Energy is a next-generation geothermal power company headquartered in Houston, Texas, that generates carbon-free, always-on electricity through enhanced geothermal systems (EGS). Founded in 2017 by Tim Latimer and Jack Norbeck, Fervo adapts horizontal drilling, distributed fiber-optic sensing, and advanced subsurface data analytics from the oil and gas industry to make geothermal energy viable in previously uneconomic locations. Its projects include the Project Red pilot in Nevada and the flagship 500 MW Cape Station development in Beaver County, Utah. Fervo trades on Nasdaq under the ticker FRVO and is backed by investors including DCVC. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network surfaced from the DCVC portfolio; Fervo Energy is a physical energy-infrastructure company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Fourier
providers.description: Fourier is an energy technology company building on-site, on-demand hydrogen production systems. Its core product is a modular, scalable device that generates hydrogen where it is needed, removing the transport and storage barriers of conventional hydrogen supply. Fourier targets three application areas: long-duration distributed storage for renewable energy, alternative fuels for heavy transportation, and cleaner feedstock for chemical and manufacturing industries. The company commercially launched its onsite hydrogen system in late 2025 and raised an $18.5M Series A led by Paramark Ventures and General Catalyst. Fourier is a hardware and infrastructure company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software developer surface.

providers.name: Terragia
providers.description: Terragia is a cellulosic biofuel company developing technology to convert cellulosic biomass such as agricultural crop residues into ethanol and other low-carbon fuels at a cost competitive with petroleum. The company uses consolidated bioprocessing (CBP) with co-treatment, employing engineered thermophilic bacteria to reduce the capital expense and number of steps in bioprocessing, targeting difficult-to-electrify transportation sectors like aviation and maritime shipping. Founded on decades of research led by Dr. Lee Lynd and supported by the US Department of Energy's Center for Bioenergy Innovation, Terragia spun out of Enchi in 2022 and is based in Lebanon, New Hampshire. It is backed by General Catalyst. Terragia is a biotech and energy company and publishes no public developer, API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Advent Solar
providers.description: Advent Solar was a silicon photovoltaic company founded in 2002 and headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, that designed and manufactured crystalline-silicon (c-Si) solar cells and modules, pioneering emitter-wrap-through cell architectures and streamlined back-contact module assembly. Backed by Battery Ventures, EnerTech Capital, @Ventures and others across roughly $109M in venture funding (including a $70M Series D in 2007), the company's assets and intellectual property were acquired by Applied Materials in late 2009 / 2010. As a physical solar-hardware manufacturer that is no longer operating independently, Advent Solar exposes no public API, developer portal, or software surface; this profile is retained as a network identity record with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Amber Wave
providers.description: AmberWave, Inc. (formerly AmberWave Systems Corporation) is a Lowell, Massachusetts deep-technology company that researches, develops, and licenses semiconductor and photovoltaic materials technology. It originated strained-silicon and aspect-ratio-trapping techniques from MIT and Bell Labs research, and today develops Ultra-Thin Silicon (UTSi) flexible solar cells and modules that weigh roughly 90% less than conventional panels, targeting lightweight commercial rooftops, off-grid power, building integration, vehicle, and aerospace applications. AmberWave is a Battery Ventures portfolio company. It publishes a corporate website but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation surface, so there are no machine-readable API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: AMEE
providers.description: AMEE (Avoiding Mass Extinctions Engine, also styled Avoidance of Mass Extinctions Engine) was a London-based environmental-intelligence company founded around 2005 by Gavin Starks out of UK firm Dgen. It ran an open web-service API and cloud database that standardized carbon-emissions and energy-consumption data across 150+ countries, letting applications apply government emission factors to tracked activities. AMEE powered carbon calculators and footprinting for clients including Google, Morgan Stanley, Radiohead, Sun Microsystems, and UK and Irish government programs (notably the Act on CO2 campaign). It raised roughly $7.5M from Union Square Ventures, OATV (O'Reilly AlphaTech Ventures), The Accelerator Group, and Amadeus Capital Partners. AMEE was acquired by Pi (PredictX) in late 2015 / early 2016 and no longer operates as an independent company; the amee.com domain currently returns HTTP 502 with no live API or developer surface.

providers.name: Bedrock Materials
providers.description: Bedrock Materials was a Chicago-based deep-tech startup founded in 2023 by Spencer Gore (CEO, previously Tesla and Enovix) and Rafael Vila (CTO, Stanford battery scientist) to manufacture engineered sodium-ion cathode active materials as a low-cost, easy-to-source alternative to lithium-ion — built from abundant sodium, manganese, iron and aluminum, and designed to drop into existing lithium-ion cell manufacturing lines for low-voltage, starter-lighting-ignition, micromobility and industrial-traction applications. It raised a $9M seed round led by Trucks Venture Capital with Refactor Capital and Version One Ventures. In April 2025 the company wound down and returned the majority of that seed capital to its investors: CEO Spencer Gore concluded that sodium-ion could not be produced cheaply enough to beat lithium iron phosphate (LFP) after lithium oversupply collapsed prices, and that energy-density gains carried steep trade-offs. Bedrock Materials was a materials-science manufacturer and never operated a developer program, public API, or developer portal; both bedrockmaterials.com and its former bedrock.inc website are now parked/for-sale domains with no company content. This profile is retained as a verified-defunct record in the API Evangelist network — there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: cdhot (Hot New Energy Technology)
providers.description: cdhot (Hot New Energy Technology) is a Chinese industrial energy-efficiency company listed in the Qiming Venture Partners portfolio. Qiming describes the company as providing EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) and EMC (energy management contracting) services to industrial customers to achieve waste heat recovery — capturing surplus process heat from industrial operations and converting it into reusable energy. The company is an engineering and energy-services business rather than a software or API provider. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass its published website at cdhot.cc did not resolve over HTTPS, redirected to www.cdhot.cc over HTTP and returned an empty HTTP 404, and no developer portal, documentation, specification, or API surface of any kind could be found.

providers.name: Clean Urban Energy
providers.description: Clean Urban Energy, Inc. was a Chicago, Illinois cleantech company that turned large commercial office buildings into grid-scale thermal energy storage assets. Its technology harnessed the existing thermal mass of a building — concrete, drywall, furnishings — by pre-cooling during off-peak hours and coasting through peak demand, effectively operating the building as a multi-megawatt battery for demand response and load shifting without installing dedicated storage hardware. The company raised a reported $7 million venture round and appears in the Battery Ventures list of all portfolio companies. As of a July 2026 review the company has no live corporate web presence: the cleanurbanenergy.com domain no longer serves company content, and no developer portal, API, documentation, or GitHub organization could be located. It is catalogued here as an inactive, non-API-provider company record.

providers.name: Estes Energy
providers.description: Estes Energy is a US-based manufacturer of advanced battery packs for heavy-duty transport. Its magnesium-alloy Magnus platform (proprietary MgCarbonit thermo-structural body) delivers roughly 225 Wh/kg for rail, marine, aviation and off-highway applications, with chemistry-agnostic (sodium, LFP, nickel) packs manufactured entirely in the United States. Backed by DCVC, Fortescue Ventures, BMW and New System Ventures. A hardware/manufacturing company with no public API, developer portal, SDK or software product surface at this time.

providers.name: Graviti
providers.description: Graviti is a Mexico City-based consumer fintech founded in 2020 that unlocks affordable access to essential home utilities for unbanked and underserved Mexican families, starting with solar water heaters financed through a pay-as-you-go (PayGo / BNPL) model of small recurring payments. Backed by 500 Global, Clocktower Technology Ventures, Mucker Capital, Active Capital, and BFA Global's Catalyst Fund, the company combines hardware installation with embedded consumer lending. Graviti is a consumer-facing product company and does not publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with an honest no-API-surface result.

providers.name: GridBank
providers.description: GridBank is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of version-one-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: energy. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Imara
providers.description: Imara Corporation was a lithium-ion battery technology startup founded in 2006 in Menlo Park, California, that grew out of research at SRI International. It designed and manufactured high-power lithium-ion battery cells and packs based on patented cathode materials science, targeting power tools, outdoor power equipment, hybrid electric vehicles, specialty applications, and power-grid energy storage. Backed by Battery Ventures and Nth Power, it raised roughly $15.65M and reached commercial cell production in 2009 before shutting down around 2010-2011 for lack of manufacturing funding. It is a hardware company with no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface, and is now defunct.

providers.name: Klir
providers.description: Klir provides an integrated water regulatory solution — software for water and wastewater utilities to manage regulatory compliance, environmental monitoring data, permits, sampling and reporting obligations in one system. Klir was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its public developer surface — APIs, documentation, SDKs and specifications — has not yet been verified, so this profile carries identity only and no API or artifact claims until a research pass confirms them.

providers.name: Lydian
providers.description: Lydian (Lydian Labs) develops modular, turnkey plants that produce sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) from captured CO2 and hydrogen. Its technology converts carbon dioxide and electrolytic hydrogen into jet fuel via a syngas production process compatible with existing aircraft, targeting deployment in under two years and capital costs roughly 50% lower than conventional SAF plants. The company markets to airlines, fuel buyers, and facility operators. Based in Charlestown, Massachusetts, Lydian is backed by Union Square Ventures. This is a hardware/industrial company with no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Marvel Tech (Mufan Power)
providers.description: Marvel Tech (Mufan Power, 慕帆动力) is a Chinese industrial power-equipment manufacturer developing next-generation zero-carbon clean power-generation technology and products. Its portfolio centers on hydrogen-fuelled gas turbine generating sets, high-speed multi-stage cantilever turbines, special-gas and TRT flow-path (通流) turbines, dry low-NOx combustors, and industrial waste-heat and waste-pressure recovery equipment. The company runs a corporate brochure website in Chinese and English (ICP 沪ICP备17001438号) and publishes no public developer, API, or SDK surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Modular Wind Energy
providers.description: Modular Wind Energy is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of battery-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: OptoAtmospherics
providers.description: OptoAtmospherics, Inc. is an Ann Arbor, Michigan company (founded 2009, spun out of Michigan Aerospace Corporation) that develops UV-based Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) systems for the wind energy industry. Its laser-based atmospheric measurement products deliver continuous wind speed, direction, temperature, and density reporting from turbine-mounted or ground-based platforms, with real-time detection of wind gusts, shear, and turbulence to improve site assessment, increase energy output, and protect turbine equipment. The business is a hardware and atmospheric-sensing venture; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or software platform. Its former domain (optoatmospherics.com) is now parked/for-sale and the product line lives on under michiganaerospace.com/optoatmospherics/.

providers.name: Proterra
providers.description: Proterra is a US-based manufacturer of high-energy lithium-ion battery systems for electric vehicles and commercial equipment, including transit buses, trucks, and off-highway EVs, with charging and fleet solutions. Originally an electric transit bus and powertrain manufacturer founded in 2004, the battery-systems business (Powered by Proterra) continues under the proterra.com domain following the 2023 restructuring. It is a physical hardware and energy-storage company backed by Obvious Ventures under its planetary-health thesis, and publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Rens Energy
providers.description: Rens Energy is a Shanghai-based distributed energy-storage and energy-management company founded in 2017. It builds distributed energy-storage systems and energy-management software that let customers deliver power and energy-balance scheduling, energy-usage analysis, and energy optimization for efficient operation and asset appreciation of their power assets. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment probing found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rovilus
providers.description: Rovilus is a seed-stage hardware startup founded in 2018 by YenChe Huang and Katherine Kan, developing thermal management technology for industrial battery packs. The company raised roughly $150K from 500 Global (formerly 500 Startups) and appears in that firm's portfolio. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this enrichment pass the company's website (rovilus.com) no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN, no NS/MX records), and no public API, developer portal, SDK, documentation, or other developer surface could be found; Rovilus is a physical battery-thermal hardware company with no API footprint.

providers.name: Safire
providers.description: Safire (Safire Technology Group, Inc.) is a Canaan Partners portfolio company operating in battery and energy-materials deep tech. It develops impact-resistant, safety-focused electrolyte technology aimed at making lithium-ion batteries more resistant to fire and physical damage. Added to the API Evangelist network as a stub from Canaan's portfolio, it is a hardware and materials-science business rather than a software vendor; an enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 probed the company's likely domains and found no public developer portal, API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Smalt
providers.description: Smalt is a Berlin-based training academy and technology platform for the green-energy installation trades. It combines a B2B installation services business (solar and, increasingly, heat pumps and other climate-trade work) with an education platform that upskills and certifies installers, plus a franchise model that lets trained installers run their own training businesses on Smalt's learning materials and tooling. Founded in 2023 and backed by General Catalyst, noa, Owl Ventures, Heartfelt, La Famiglia and Loric Ventures, Smalt is a workforce/services company rather than an API provider; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface to catalog.

providers.name: Solar City
providers.description: SolarCity was a San Mateo, California based provider of residential and commercial solar energy systems, founded in 2006 by brothers Peter and Lyndon Rive with backing and board chairmanship from their cousin Elon Musk. The company designed, financed, installed, and monitored rooftop solar and energy-storage systems, and became the largest residential solar installer in the United States before its 2012 IPO (NASDAQ: SCTY). In November 2016 SolarCity was acquired by Tesla, Inc. in an all-stock deal valued at roughly 2.6 billion US dollars and was absorbed into Tesla's energy-generation and storage business; the SolarCity brand was subsequently retired and its products relaunched under Tesla (Solar Roof, Solar Panels, Powerwall). SolarCity no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no standalone developer portal, public API, or OpenAPI surface. The solarcity.com domain remains registered under Tesla's DNS infrastructure but no longer serves a live website.

providers.name: SunFarmer
providers.description: SunFarmer is a solar energy company operating primarily in Nepal that designs, installs, finances, and services solar power systems for health facilities, schools, agriculture, and businesses. Its mission is to make reliable solar energy affordable across underserved communities, powering water pumping, clinics, and irrigation. SunFarmer reports over 3.2 million cubic meters of water pumped, 1.5+ million units of clean electricity generated, and nearly 1.8 million kilograms of CO2 offset. It offers a "Get Solar" customer path and a "Give Solar" donation program. It is a direct-to-customer solar services and social-impact provider with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Zephyr Fusion
providers.description: Zephyr Fusion is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company building the first in-orbit fusion power source: a compact, megawatt-class magnetic-confinement fusion reactor designed to enable large-scale industry in space at a fraction of the cost of equivalent solar. Founded by former Lawrence Livermore and Oak Ridge National Laboratory physicists, the company targets microgravity manufacturing, orbital data centers, defense, propulsion, and human habitation in space, exploiting the vacuum of space to accommodate larger plasma regions than Earth-based reactors. As an early-stage deep-tech hardware company, Zephyr Fusion currently publishes no public API, developer platform, SDK, or machine-readable specification; this profile captures its identity in the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 confirmed no API surface exists (no api./docs./developer. hosts resolve; no /developers, /docs, or /.well-known discovery surface is published).

providers.name: Siluria Technologies
providers.description: Siluria Technologies is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: cleantech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Zolar
providers.description: Zolar is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of partech and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: Climate. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: ClearFlame Engines
providers.description: ClearFlame Engine Technologies was a Woodridge, Illinois clean-combustion engine startup founded in 2016 by BJ Johnson and Julie Blumreiter, developing a retrofit technology that let conventional heavy-duty diesel engines run on ethanol and other low-carbon liquid fuels for the hard-to-electrify segments of transportation — long-haul trucking, agriculture, construction and other non-road diesel applications. It raised roughly $50M across Series A and B rounds from venture and industrial investors including John Deere, and appeared on secondary markets such as Forge Global. The company is a hardware and powertrain engineering business with no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable specifications; by 2025 it had lost investor support, its co-founder CEO had departed, it was listed as not in good standing in Illinois, and it moved toward bankruptcy and asset liquidation. Its website no longer serves content.

providers.name: Enevate
providers.description: Enevate Corporation was an Irvine, California battery technology company that developed and licensed silicon-dominant lithium-ion anode and cell technology — marketed as HD-Energy and XFC-Energy — aimed at extreme fast charging (roughly five minutes to a substantial state of charge), high energy density, and cold-weather performance for electric vehicles, with a licensing rather than cell-manufacturing business model. It was a materials and cell-chemistry licensor, not a software vendor, and it never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or webhook surface. As of an August 2026 probe the company's own domain no longer serves a company website: enevate.com redirects to a "Website Temporarily Unavailable" domain notice stating the prior Enevate Corporation website has been retired and the domain is now under new ownership following an asset acquisition process, and that all previously published statements about products, services, partnerships and company operations should no longer be considered current. This profile is retained as a recorded absence with the probe evidence attached.

providers.name: Fulcrum BioEnergy
providers.description: Fulcrum BioEnergy, Inc. was a Pleasanton, California waste-to-fuels project developer founded in 2007 that converted municipal solid waste into synthetic crude oil for refining into sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and diesel, using a shred-and-sort feedstock line feeding a gasifier and a Fischer-Tropsch conversion train. Its first and only commercial plant, the Sierra BioFuels Plant in the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center outside Reno, Nevada, was designed to take roughly 175,000-219,000 tons of household garbage a year from an adjacent feedstock processing facility and began production in late 2022. The company raised on the order of a billion dollars in equity, debt and government support over its life, including strategic investments and offtake alliances with United Airlines, Waste Management, Cathay Pacific Airways, Marubeni and bp, plus a US Department of Energy loan guarantee, USDA loan guarantee and Department of Defense grants; E. James Macias led it as president and CEO through its build-out years, and it had announced follow-on projects including a Gary, Indiana plant and the NorthPoint facility in the UK. The Sierra plant stopped operating in mid-May 2024 after persistent equipment problems, the company laid off essentially its entire workforce and took its website down, and on 2024-09-09 Fulcrum BioEnergy, Fulcrum Sierra Holdings and Fulcrum Sierra Finance Co. filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware listing more than $456 million owed to over 200 creditors. A November 2024 auction sold the biorefinery to Switch, Ltd. for $55 million and the adjacent feedstock processing facility to Refuse Inc., a WM subsidiary; the plan of liquidation was confirmed in April 2025 and went effective in May 2025. Fulcrum was an industrial energy project developer rather than a software company and never published a developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification — a Wayback index of its corporate site from 2008 through 2024 turns up no developer, reference, or spec path of any kind. Its corporate host fulcrum-bioenergy.com no longer resolves to any web server, and the alternate registration fulcrumbioenergy.com is parked on the GoDaddy/Afternic aftermarket and listed for sale. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.

providers.name: Accenta
providers.description: Accenta is a French energy and carbon performance company for real estate portfolios, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt. It combines AI-driven building control (an intelligent building management system plus an Accenta Communication Box for sites with no BMS) with low-carbon heat and cold production built on shallow geothermal energy, inter-seasonal geostorage, heat pumps and solar, and it wraps the whole package in audit, design, build, operate, financing and performance-contract services. Accenta says it manages roughly 10 million square metres of real estate for owners such as Airbus, Prologis, Icade, Redevco and Decathlon, targeting energy reductions up to 80% and CO2 reductions up to 95%. Its software platform is effiPilot, acquired in 2020, delivered as a per-customer tenant on accenta.ai with a web application, an Android app and an HTTP API whose reference documentation sits behind the customer login.

providers.name: Anthemis Group
providers.description: Anthemis Group is a London-based venture capital and asset management firm founded in 2010 by Amy Nauiokas (Group CEO) and Sean Park (Group CIO), both former capital-markets executives. Anthemis invests to "architect the digital economy," concentrating on financial technology and its adjacencies: embedded finance, payments and banking infrastructure, insurtech, wealthtech, crypto and digital assets, climate and agtech finance, and applied AI for financial services. The firm invests primarily at pre-seed, seed, Series A and early Series B, writing checks generally in the ~$2M-$3M range, and pairs venture investing with an advisory and platform practice aimed at systematically transforming financial services. Anthemis is headquartered in London with additional presence in New York, Geneva, Amsterdam, Lisbon and Dallas, manages roughly $500M in assets, and has backed 300+ companies including Betterment, eToro, Carta, Pipe, TrueLayer, Tide, Currencycloud, Atom Bank and The Climate Corporation.

providers.name: Atomico
providers.description: Atomico is a London-headquartered European venture capital firm founded in 2006 by Niklas Zennstrom, co-founder of Skype and Kazaa. Atomico partners with Europe's most ambitious technology founders from the earliest stages to pre-IPO across two dedicated teams: a Venture team that invests predominantly at Series A alongside occasional Seed opportunities, and a Growth team that invests from Series B to pre-IPO. In September 2024 the firm closed its largest ever fundraise, $1.24 billion across two funds - a $754M Atomico Growth VI vehicle and a $485M Atomico Venture VI vehicle - bringing total capital raised across seven funds to more than $5 billion. Growth-stage checks typically range from roughly $10M to $50M+. Atomico invests broadly across enterprise software, fintech, consumer, health, AI, developer tools, infrastructure, industrial and climate technology, with an explicit thesis that European technology has come of age. The firm operates offices in London, Paris, Berlin and Stockholm and is known for backing category-defining companies including Klarna, Stripe, Supercell, Graphcore, DeepL, Pipedrive, Truecaller, Wellhub, Lilium, Compass, Hinge Health and Sorare. Atomico also publishes the annual State of European Tech report, the definitive data-driven analysis of the European technology ecosystem.

providers.name: CarbonFarm
providers.description: CarbonFarm Technology is a French climate-tech company (registered in Nanterre, SIREN 912160389) that uses satellite imagery and proprietary machine-learning models to monitor, measure and verify greenhouse-gas reductions in rice production. Rice accounts for roughly 12% of global methane emissions, and practices such as Alternate Wetting and Drying can cut paddy methane substantially — but conventional MRV depends on self-declared practices recorded in paper logbooks, which is expensive to collect from smallholders and open to fraud. CarbonFarm detects water-management and straw-management practices remotely at paddy level, estimates baseline and project emissions with validated models, and verifies additionality, at a fraction of the cost of ground-based MRV. Customers and partners named publicly include Mars Food, Tilda, Beneo, Amru Rice, Vida Energy, Fortune Rice, Ostrom Climate, Core Carbon X, the Sustainable Rice Platform, UNDP, Danone, Rikolto, Cornell University, IRRI and Regrow Ag. CarbonFarm operates no developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, SDK or public API product, and the client platform sits behind an Auth0 organization login.
